sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca-
śāntātītaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā śāntim āpnoti mānavaḥ /
bhaiṣajyaṃ ca gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān rogān vyapohati //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच-
शान्तातीतं गणं हुत्वा शान्तिम् आप्नोति मानवः /
भैषज्यं च गणं हुत्वा सर्वान् रोगान् व्यपोहति //
text_mt:
Puṣkara said:
Offering the Śāntātīta hymn-group into the fire, a man attains peace; / and offering the Bhaiṣajya hymn-group, he dispels all diseases.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣaptīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
kvacin nāapnoti ca bhayaṃ hutvā caivābhayaṃ gaṇam //
meaning:
त्रिषप्तीयं गणं हुत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
क्वचिन् नाअप्नोति च भयं हुत्वा चैवाभयं गणम् //
text_mt: Offering the Triṣaptīya hymn-group, one is freed from all sins; / and offering the Abhaya hymn-group, one encounters no fear anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
na parājāyate rāma gaṇaṃ hutvāparājitam /
āyuṣyaṃ ca gaṇam hutvā cāpamṛtyūṃ vyapohati //
meaning:
न पराजायते राम गणं हुत्वापराजितम् /
आयुष्यं च गणम् हुत्वा चापमृत्यूं व्यपोहति //
text_mt: One is not defeated, O Rāma, after offering the Aparājita hymn-group; / and offering the Āyuṣya hymn-group, one wards off untimely death.

sanskrit_iast:
svastim āpnoti sarvatra hutvā svastyayanaṃ gaṇaṃ /
śreyasā yogam āpnoti śarmavarmagaṇaṃ tathā //
vāstoṣpatyagaṇaṃ hutvā vāstudoṣān vyapohati /
tathā raudragaṇaṃ hutvā sarvān doṣān vyapohati //
meaning:
स्वस्तिम् आप्नोति सर्वत्र हुत्वा स्वस्त्ययनं गणं /
श्रेयसा योगम् आप्नोति शर्मवर्मगणं तथा //
वास्तोष्पत्यगणं हुत्वा वास्तुदोषान् व्यपोहति /
तथा रौद्रगणं हुत्वा सर्वान् दोषान् व्यपोहति //
text_mt:
One attains well-being everywhere by offering the Svastyayana hymn-group; / likewise, through the Śarmavarman hymn-group one attains union with supreme good.

Offering the Vāstoṣpatya hymn-group, one dispels architectural defects; / likewise, offering the Raudra hymn-group, one removes all faults.

sanskrit_iast: etair daśagaṇair homo hy aṣṭādaśasu śāntiṣu //
meaning: एतैर् दशगणैर् होमो ह्य् अष्टादशसु शान्तिषु //
text_mt: Fire-oblation with these ten hymn-groups is indeed performed in the eighteen pacification rites:

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavī śāntir aindrī ca brāhmī raudrī tathaiva ca /
vāyavyā vāruṇī caiva kauberī bhārgavī tathā //
meaning:
वैष्णवी शान्तिर् ऐन्द्री च ब्राह्मी रौद्री तथैव च /
वायव्या वारुणी चैव कौबेरी भार्गवी तथा //
text_mt: The pacification rites dedicated to Viṣṇu, Indra, Brahmā, and Rudra, / Vāyu, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Bhṛgu;

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyā tathā tvāṣṭrī kaumārī vahnidevatā /
mārudgaṇā ca gāndharvī śāntair nairṛtakī tathā //
śāntir āṅgirasī yāmyā pārthivī ca bhṛgūttama /
meaning:
प्राजापत्या तथा त्वाष्ट्री कौमारी वह्निदेवता /
मारुद्गणा च गान्धर्वी शान्तैर् नैरृतकी तथा //
शान्तिर् आङ्गिरसी याम्या पार्थिवी च भृगूत्तम /
text_mt:
Prajāpati, Tvaṣṭṛ, Kumāra, and the fire-god; / the Maruts, Gandharvas, and the pacification rite to Nirṛti;

the pacification rites to Aṅgiras, Yama, and Pṛthivī, O best of the Bhṛgus.

sanskrit_iast:
etās tu śāntayaḥ proktāḥ sarvakarmahitāḥ sadā //
yas tvā mṛtyur iti hy etaj japtaṃ mṛtyuvināśanaṃ /
meaning:
एतास् तु शान्तयः प्रोक्ताः सर्वकर्महिताः सदा //
यस् त्वा मृत्युर् इति ह्य् एतज् जप्तं मृत्युविनाशनं /
text_mt:
These pacification rites are declared to be beneficial for all undertakings at all times.

Recitation of 'yas tvā mṛtyuḥ' destroys death.

sanskrit_iast: hutvā ca mātṛnāmāni kāmān evam avāpnuyāt //
meaning: हुत्वा च मातृनामानि कामान् एवम् अवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: And offering the names of the Mothers into the fire, one obtains desires in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
suparṇas tveti hutvā ca bhujagair naiva bādhyate /
[Bhattacharyya edits bhujagainava bādhyate, which can be just a typo!]
yasyedaṃ bhūmyām iti ca bhūmikāmo japet sadā //
meaning:
सुपर्णस् त्वेति हुत्वा च भुजगैर् नैव बाध्यते /
[भत्तछर्य्य एदित्स् भुजगैनव बाध्यते, wहिछ् चन् बे जुस्त् अ त्य्पो!]
यस्येदं भूम्याम् इति च भूमिकामो जपेत् सदा //
text_mt: Offering with 'suparṇas tvā', one is not afflicted by snakes; / and one desiring land should constantly mutter 'yasyedaṃ bhūmyām'.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivyām uttamo 'sīti hutaṃ śraiṣṭhyapradaṃ sadā /
audumbaraṃ yo na iti tathā vīryavivardhanam //
meaning:
पृथिव्याम् उत्तमो ऽसीति हुतं श्रैष्ठ्यप्रदं सदा /
औदुम्बरं यो न इति तथा वीर्यविवर्धनम् //
text_mt: Offered with 'pṛthivyām uttamo 'si', it always bestows supremacy; / likewise, with 'audumbaraṃ yo naḥ', it increases vigor.

sanskrit_iast:
indreṇa dattam ity etat sarvabādhāvināśanam /
hiraṇyavarṇā iti ca snānaṃ pāpaharaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
इन्द्रेण दत्तम् इत्य् एतत् सर्वबाधाविनाशनम् /
हिरण्यवर्णा इति च स्नानं पापहरं भवेत् //
text_mt: The verse 'indreṇa dattam' destroys all obstacles; / and bathing with 'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ' removes sins.

sanskrit_iast:
asitasyeti sarvāṇi viṣaghnāni bhṛgūttama /
sarasvatīti mantrāṃś ca viṣaghnān nirviśed budhaḥ //
śarabhādīni sarvāṇi piśācakṣapaṇāni ca /
meaning:
असितस्येति सर्वाणि विषघ्नानि भृगूत्तम /
सरस्वतीति मन्त्रांश् च विषघ्नान् निर्विशेद् बुधः //
शरभादीनि सर्वाणि पिशाचक्षपणानि च /
text_mt:
All verses beginning with 'asitasya' destroy poison, O best of the Bhṛgus; / and a wise man should employ the mantras beginning with 'sarasvatī' to eliminate poison.

All mantras beginning with 'śarabha' destroy Piśācas.

sanskrit_iast: imā devīti mantraś ca sarvaśāntikaraḥ paraḥ //
meaning: इमा देवीति मन्त्रश् च सर्वशान्तिकरः परः //
text_mt: And the mantra 'imā devīḥ' is supreme, effecting all pacification.

sanskrit_iast:
devā maruta ity etat sarvakāmakaraṃ bhavet /
yamasya lokād ity etad duḥsvapnaśamanaṃ paraṃ //
meaning:
देवा मरुत इत्य् एतत् सर्वकामकरं भवेत् /
यमस्य लोकाद् इत्य् एतद् दुःस्वप्नशमनं परं //
text_mt: The verse 'devā marutaḥ' fulfills all desires; / 'yamasya lokāt' is supreme in pacifying bad dreams.

sanskrit_iast:
agner va iti cāpy etat kathitaṃ manyunāśanam /
ūrdhvo bhavati vijñeyaḥ kṛtvā sthānakaraḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
अग्नेर् व इति चाप्य् एतत् कथितं मन्युनाशनम् /
ऊर्ध्वो भवति विज्ञेयः कृत्वा स्थानकरः परः //
text_mt: 'agner vaḥ' is also taught as destroying anger; / one should know that performing [rites with] 'ūrdhvo bhavati' is supreme, securing high station.

sanskrit_iast:
indraṃ vayaṃ vaṇijam iti paṇyalābhakaraṃ param /
[Bhattacharyya: baṇijaṃ]
kāmo me rājña ity etat strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam //
meaning:
इन्द्रं वयं वणिजम् इति पण्यलाभकरं परम् /
[भत्तछर्य्य: बणिजं]
कामो मे राज्ञ इत्य् एतत् स्त्रीणां सौभाग्यवर्धनम् //
text_mt: 'indraṃ vayaṃ vaṇijam' is supreme in bringing profit from trade; / 'kāmo me rājñaḥ' increases good fortune for women.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrāya karṇam ity etat karṇaprasyandane japet /
bhadrāsy akṣirodhe jātā karṇaprasyandane tathā //
meaning:
भद्राय कर्णम् इत्य् एतत् कर्णप्रस्यन्दने जपेत् /
भद्रास्य् अक्षिरोधे जाता कर्णप्रस्यन्दने तथा //
text_mt: One should mutter 'bhadrāya karṇam' when there is discharge from the ear; / likewise 'bhadrāsy akṣirodhe jātā' for ear discharge.

sanskrit_iast:
tubyam eva jarimann āyuṣyaṃ tu hutaṃ bhavet /
āyātu mitra ity etan mitralabdhikaraṃ hutam //
meaning:
तुब्यम् एव जरिमन्न् आयुष्यं तु हुतं भवेत् /
आयातु मित्र इत्य् एतन् मित्रलब्धिकरं हुतम् //
text_mt: Offered with 'tubhyam eva jariman', it promotes longevity; / offered with 'āyātu mitraḥ', it brings about the acquisition of friends.

sanskrit_iast:
āśāsānam idaṃ janā miśradhānyena homayet /
ādhipatyam avāpnoti sarvatra manujottama //
meaning:
आशासानम् इदं जना मिश्रधान्येन होमयेत् /
आधिपत्यम् अवाप्नोति सर्वत्र मनुजोत्तम //
text_mt: One should offer 'āśāsānam idaṃ janāḥ' into the fire with mixed grains; / thereby one attains sovereignty everywhere, O best of men.

sanskrit_iast:
agne gobhir na ity etad gavāṃ vṛddhikaraṃ param /
dvādaśāhaṃ tu juhuyāt parākeṇa viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अग्ने गोभिर् न इत्य् एतद् गवां वृद्धिकरं परम् /
द्वादशाहं तु जुहुयात् पराकेण विशेषतः //
text_mt: 'agne gobhir naḥ' is supreme for increasing cattle; / one should offer it especially for twelve days along with the Parāka fast.

sanskrit_iast:
śānto agnir itīty etad grāmasvāsthyakaraṃ bhavet /
tasmād grāmān mṛdā kṛtvā vedisāmyaṃ samaśnute //
meaning:
शान्तो अग्निर् इतीत्य् एतद् ग्रामस्वास्थ्यकरं भवेत् /
तस्माद् ग्रामान् मृदा कृत्वा वेदिसाम्यं समश्नुते //
text_mt: 'śānto agniḥ' brings well-being to a village; / having fashioned an altar identical to it with clay from that village, one enjoys [prosperity].

sanskrit_iast:
vidmāsya sarvā cittāni rāṣṭrasvīkaraṇāni tu /
tribhyo rudrebhya ity etad vāstoṣpatam udāhṛtam //
meaning:
विद्मास्य सर्वा चित्तानि राष्ट्रस्वीकरणानि तु /
त्रिभ्यो रुद्रेभ्य इत्य् एतद् वास्तोष्पतम् उदाहृतम् //
text_mt: [The hymns beginning with] 'vidmāsya sarvā cittāni' serve to secure the kingdom; / 'tribhyo rudrebhyaḥ' is declared as related to the deity of the dwelling.

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaṃ dhruveṇeti hutaṃ sthānalābhakaraṃ bhavet /
acyutā dyaus tathā rāma kathitaṃ sthānalābhadam //
meaning:
ध्रुवं ध्रुवेणेति हुतं स्थानलाभकरं भवेत् /
अच्युता द्यौस् तथा राम कथितं स्थानलाभदम् //
text_mt: Offered with 'dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa', it brings the acquisition of a dwelling; / likewise, 'acyutā dyauḥ', O Rāma, is declared to bestow a stable abode.

sanskrit_iast:
payo deveṣv iti hutaṃ rāyaspoṣakaraṃ param /
yunakrasīreti śunā kṛṣilābhakaraṃ bhavet //
meaning:
पयो देवेष्व् इति हुतं रायस्पोषकरं परम् /
युनक्रसीरेति शुना कृषिलाभकरं भवेत् //
text_mt: Offered with 'payo deveṣu', it is supreme for increasing wealth; / with 'yunakta sīrā', along with 'śunām', it brings agricultural success.

sanskrit_iast:
ayaṃ te yonir ity etat putralābhakaraṃ bhavet /
śunaṃ vatsān tathā hy etad gavāṃ vṛddhikaraṃ hutam //
... meti kathitaṃ sarvatśraiṣṭhyakārakam /
meaning:
अयं ते योनिर् इत्य् एतत् पुत्रलाभकरं भवेत् /
शुनं वत्सान् तथा ह्य् एतद् गवां वृद्धिकरं हुतम् //
... मेति कथितं सर्वत्श्रैष्ठ्यकारकम् /
text_mt:
'ayaṃ te yoniḥ' brings the acquisition of a son; / and 'śunaṃ vatsān', when offered into the fire, increases cattle.

[The mantra beginning with] '... mā' is declared to produce supremacy everywhere.

sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ te bhaga ity etad bhavet saubhāgyavardhanaṃ //
meaning: अहं ते भग इत्य् एतद् भवेत् सौभाग्यवर्धनं //
text_mt: 'ahaṃ te bhagaḥ' increases good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
ye te pāśās tathāpy etad bandhanān mokṣakārakam /
yo na sva iti cāpy etac chatrunāśakaraṃ param //
meaning:
ये ते पाशास् तथाप्य् एतद् बन्धनान् मोक्षकारकम् /
यो न स्व इति चाप्य् एतच् छत्रुनाशकरं परम् //
text_mt: 'ye te pāśāḥ' brings liberation from fetters; / and 'yo naḥ svaḥ' is supreme in destroying enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
sapatnahanam iti tathā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā /
tvam uttamam itīty etad yaśaso vardhanaṃ param //
meaning:
सपत्नहनम् इति तथा नात्र कार्या विचारणा /
त्वम् उत्तमम् इतीत्य् एतद् यशसो वर्धनं परम् //
text_mt: Likewise 'sapatnahanam'—there is no doubt about this; / 'tvam uttamam' is supreme in increasing renown.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā mṛgo gopayasi strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam /
ā no agna ity etac ca kathitaṃ patilābhadam //
meaning:
यथा मृगो गोपयसि स्त्रीणां सौभाग्यवर्धनम् /
आ नो अग्न इत्य् एतच् च कथितं पतिलाभदम् //
text_mt: 'yathā mṛgo gopayasi' increases good fortune for women; / and 'ā no agne' is declared to bestow a husband.

sanskrit_iast:
yena vehad iṣaṃ caiva garbhalābhakaraṃ bhavet /
imaṃ tapasvinn iti tathā bhavet saubhāgyavardhanam //
meaning:
येन वेहद् इषं चैव गर्भलाभकरं भवेत् /
इमं तपस्विन्न् इति तथा भवेत् सौभाग्यवर्धनम् //
text_mt: 'yena vehat' and 'iṣam' bring about conception; / likewise 'imaṃ tapasvin' increases good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
yat pṛthivyā anāvṛttaṃ hutam etad yathāvidhi /
[Bhattacharyya typo: pṛvivyā]
kṛtvā tu śaṃsanaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā //
meaning:
यत् पृथिव्या अनावृत्तं हुतम् एतद् यथाविधि /
[भत्तछर्य्य त्य्पो: पृविव्या]
कृत्वा तु शंसनं ज्ञेयं नात्र कार्या विचारणा //
text_mt: Offered according to rule with 'yat pṛthivyā anāvṛttam', / after making recitation, it is known to be effective; there is no doubt about this.

sanskrit_iast:
...... /
śivaḥ śivābhir ity etad bhavec chreyas^karaṃ param //
meaning:
...... /
शिवः शिवाभिर् इत्य् एतद् भवेच् छ्रेयस्^करं परम् //
text_mt: […] / 'śivaḥ śivābhiḥ' is supreme in bringing welfare.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtyādūṣaṇa ity etat kṛtyādūṣaṇam ucyate /
bṛhaspatiḥ paripātu pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
कृत्यादूषण इत्य् एतत् कृत्यादूषणम् उच्यते /
बृहस्पतिः परिपातु पथि स्वस्त्ययनं भवेत् //
text_mt: 'kṛtyādūṣaṇaḥ' is declared to counteract sorcery; / 'bṛhaspatiḥ paripātu' is a benedictory rite for journeys.

sanskrit_iast:
mano nv edam abhayadaṃ pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet /
ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣo bhaved agniprasādataḥ //
saṃvatsaraṃ tu śirasā dhārayed yo hutāśanam //
[Bhattacharyya: hūtāśanam]
mantram etaj japen nityam āgneyāśāmukhaḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
मनो न्व् एदम् अभयदं पथि स्वस्त्ययनं भवेत् /
अयं नो अग्निर् अध्यक्षो भवेद् अग्निप्रसादतः //
संवत्सरं तु शिरसा धारयेद् यो हुताशनम् //
[भत्तछर्य्य: हूताशनम्]
मन्त्रम् एतज् जपेन् नित्यम् आग्नेयाशामुखः स्थितः //
text_mt:
'mano nv edam' bestows safety and is a benedictory rite for journeys; / 'ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣaḥ' succeeds through the grace of Agni.

He who carries the sacred fire on his head for a year,

should constantly mutter this mantra facing the south-eastern quarter.

sanskrit_iast: anagnijvalanaṃ kuryād rāma saṃvatsare gate //
meaning: अनग्निज्वलनं कुर्याद् राम संवत्सरे गते //
text_mt: When the year has elapsed, O Rāma, he can make fire kindle without fire.

sanskrit_iast:
dūṣyā dūṣītty etaj japen mantram anuttamam /
kuryāt pratisarābandhaṃ sarvadoṣanibarhaṇam //
meaning:
दूष्या दूषीत्त्य् एतज् जपेन् मन्त्रम् अनुत्तमम् /
कुर्यात् प्रतिसराबन्धं सर्वदोषनिबर्हणम् //
text_mt: One should mutter the unsurpassed mantra 'dūṣyā dūṣiḥ'; / and one should perform the tying of the protective amulet-cord, which destroys all evils.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇasūktañ ca kathitaṃ tathā prāṇavivardhanam /
muñcāmi tveti kathitam apamṛtyuvimokṣaṇam //
meaning:
प्राणसूक्तञ् च कथितं तथा प्राणविवर्धनम् /
मुञ्चामि त्वेति कथितम् अपमृत्युविमोक्षणम् //
text_mt: The Prāṇasūkta is taught as increasing life-force; / 'muñcāmi tvā' is taught as liberation from untimely death.

sanskrit_iast:
atharvaśiraso 'dhyetā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate /
paramaṃ pāvanaṃ tad dhi sarvakalmaṣanāśanam //
meaning:
अथर्वशिरसो ऽध्येता सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते /
परमं पावनं तद् धि सर्वकल्मषनाशनम् //
text_mt: A student of the Atharvaśiras is freed from all sins; / for that is supremely purifying and the destroyer of all impurities.

sanskrit_iast:
evam ete śubhā mantrāḥ prativedaṃ mayā tava /
samāsāt kathitā rāma samuddhṛtya pradhānataḥ //
meaning:
एवम् एते शुभा मन्त्राः प्रतिवेदं मया तव /
समासात् कथिता राम समुद्धृत्य प्रधानतः //
text_mt: Thus these auspicious mantras have been related to you by me for each Veda, / in summary, O Rāma, by extracting the principal ones.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasya ca mantrasya viniyogāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
[Bhattacharyya: viniyogaḥ]
kathitā bhṛguśārdūla purāṇaiḥ sumahātmabhiḥ //
meaning:
एकैकस्य च मन्त्रस्य विनियोगाः सहस्रशः /
[भत्तछर्य्य: विनियोगः]
कथिता भृगुशार्दूल पुराणैः सुमहात्मभिः //
text_mt: Thousands of ritual applications for each single mantra / have been taught, O tiger among the Bhṛgus, by the ancient high-souled sages.

sanskrit_iast:
na te śakyā mahābhāga vaktuṃ varṣaśatair api /
prādhānyena tu mantrāṇāṃ kiñcit karma taveritam //
meaning:
न ते शक्या महाभाग वक्तुं वर्षशतैर् अपि /
प्राधान्येन तु मन्त्राणां किञ्चित् कर्म तवेरितम् //
text_mt: They cannot be spoken, O fortunate one, even in hundreds of years; / nevertheless, through the pre-eminent mantras, some rituals have been taught to you.

sanskrit_iast:
home yatra na nirdiṣṭaṃ mayā dravyaṃ purā tava /
havīṃṣi tatra vakṣyāmi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
होमे यत्र न निर्दिष्टं मया द्रव्यं पुरा तव /
हवींषि तत्र वक्ष्यामि तानि मे गदतः शृणु //
text_mt: Where no material for fire-oblation was specified by me to you previously, / I shall tell you the oblation materials for that; listen to me speak them.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ yajñiyānān tu samidhaḥ prathamaṃ haviḥ /
ājyañ ca vrīhayaś caiva tathā vai gaurasarṣapāḥ //
akṣatāni tilāś caiva dadhi kṣīrañ ca bhārgava /
meaning:
वृक्षाणां यज्ञियानान् तु समिधः प्रथमं हविः /
आज्यञ् च व्रीहयश् चैव तथा वै गौरसर्षपाः //
अक्षतानि तिलाश् चैव दधि क्षीरञ् च भार्गव /
text_mt:
Sacrificial firewood of sacrificial trees is the primary oblation material, / along with clarified butter, rice grains, and white mustard seeds;

unbroken barley grains, sesame seeds, curd, and milk, O Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast: darbhās tathaiva dūrvāś ca bilvāni kamalāni ca //
meaning: दर्भास् तथैव दूर्वाश् च बिल्वानि कमलानि च //
text_mt: darbha grass, and likewise dūrvā grass, bilva fruits, and lotuses;

sanskrit_iast:
śāntipuṣṭikarāṇy āhur dravyāṇy etāni bhārgava /
tailendhanāni dharmajña rājikāṃ rudhiraṃ viṣam /
samidhaḥ kaṇṭakopetā abhicāreṣu yojayet //
meaning:
शान्तिपुष्टिकराण्य् आहुर् द्रव्याण्य् एतानि भार्गव /
तैलेन्धनानि धर्मज्ञ राजिकां रुधिरं विषम् /
समिधः कण्टकोपेता अभिचारेषु योजयेत् //
text_mt:
these materials, O Bhārgava, are said to produce pacification and nourishment.
O knower of dharma, in rites of sorcery one should employ
sacrificial firewood with thorns, oil as fuel, black mustard, blood, and poison.

sanskrit_iast:
ārṣaṃ vai daivataṃ chandas tv avijñāya bhṛgūttama /
mantrasya tena mantreṇa japyahomau na kārayet //
meaning:
आर्षं वै दैवतं छन्दस् त्व् अविज्ञाय भृगूत्तम /
मन्त्रस्य तेन मन्त्रेण जप्यहोमौ न कारयेत् //
text_mt:
Without knowing the seer, deity, and meter
of a mantra, O best of the Bhṛgus, one should not perform muttered recitation and fire-oblation with that mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
chandasi brāhmaṇe sūkte yad avyaktaṃ pradṛśyate /
vidvadbhiḥ saha niścitya tad yajñam avatārayet //
meaning:
छन्दसि ब्राह्मणे सूक्ते यद् अव्यक्तं प्रदृश्यते /
विद्वद्भिः सह निश्चित्य तद् यज्ञम् अवतारयेत् //
text_mt:
Whatever appears unexpressed in meter, Brāhmaṇa, or hymn,
one should ascertain together with learned scholars and then introduce it into the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
sambhārā ye yathā yatra yāni dravyāṇi yo vidhiḥ /
śākhāṃ prati tathā tatra tat pramāṇam iti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
सम्भारा ये यथा यत्र यानि द्रव्याणि यो विधिः /
शाखां प्रति तथा तत्र तत् प्रमाणम् इति स्थितिः //
text_mt:
Which requisites [are to be used], how, where, which substances, and what rule—
such is the established principle: in each case, the authority is according to one's own Vedic branch.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ svasūtram atikramya parasūtreṇa vartate /
apramāṇam ṛṣiṃ kṛtvā so 'py adharmeṇa yujyate //
meaning:
यः स्वसूत्रम् अतिक्रम्य परसूत्रेण वर्तते /
अप्रमाणम् ऋषिं कृत्वा सो ऽप्य् अधर्मेण युज्यते //
text_mt:
He who, transgressing his own Sūtra, conducts himself by another's Sūtra,
rendering the seer non-authoritative, becomes joined with unrighteousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena svasūtraṃ na vilaṅghayet /
prāktantrottaratantre dve svaśākhāpratyaye dvija /
sarvakarmasu kartavye madhye karma vidhīyate //
meaning:
तस्मात् सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्वसूत्रं न विलङ्घयेत् /
प्राक्तन्त्रोत्तरतन्त्रे द्वे स्वशाखाप्रत्यये द्विज /
सर्वकर्मसु कर्तव्ये मध्ये कर्म विधीयते //
text_mt:
Therefore, with every effort one should not transgress one's own Sūtra.
O twice-born, in all rites the two—the preliminary ritual framework and the concluding ritual framework—must be performed according to one's own Vedic branch; the main rite is prescribed between them.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca
atīva sumukhārādhyo devo viṣṇur urukramaḥ
stutena darśayām āsa viśvarūpaṃ dvijanmanām //
meaning:
वज्र उवाच
अतीव सुमुखाराध्यो देवो विष्णुर् उरुक्रमः
स्तुतेन दर्शयाम् आस विश्वरूपं द्विजन्मनाम् //
text_mt:
Vajra said:
The god Viṣṇu of wide strides, exceedingly easy to propitiate for the well-disposed,
revealed his universal form to the twice-born when praised.

sanskrit_iast:
prasādaṃ paramaṃ tasya brūhi bhaktajane mama
tṛptiṃ brahman na gacchāmi śṛṇvann etat kathāmṛtam //
meaning:
प्रसादं परमं तस्य ब्रूहि भक्तजने मम
तृप्तिं ब्रह्मन् न गच्छामि शृण्वन्न् एतत् कथामृतम् //
text_mt:
Tell me of his supreme grace toward his devoted people;
O brāhmaṇa, I do not reach satiety while listening to this nectar of stories.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
sa vidhijño mahārāja mātaliḥ śakrasārathiḥ
tasyāsti sadṛśī kanyā guṇakāśīti viśrutā //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
स विधिज्ञो महाराज मातलिः शक्रसारथिः
तस्यास्ति सदृशी कन्या गुणकाशीति विश्रुता //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
O great king, Śakra's charioteer Mātali, who knew the proper rules,
had a daughter worthy of him, renowned as Guṇakeśī.

sanskrit_iast:
mātalir nāradaś caiva anveṣṭuṃ tad vanaṃ (?) purā
caṃkramyamāṇau sakalam ārghakasyātmajātmajam //
meaning:
मातलिर् नारदश् चैव अन्वेष्टुं तद् वनं (?) पुरा
चंक्रम्यमाणौ सकलम् आर्घकस्यात्मजात्मजम् //
text_mt:
Formerly, Mātali and Nārada,
roaming across the entire [earth] to search [for a groom], saw the grandson of Āryaka,

sanskrit_iast:
sumukhākhyaṃ dadṛśatus tau gṛhītvā gatāv ubhau
nāge śakraṃ tataḥ śakrād ayācetāṃ tu tāv ubhau //
meaning:
सुमुखाख्यं ददृशतुस् तौ गृहीत्वा गताव् उभौ
नागे शक्रं ततः शक्राद् अयाचेतां तु ताव् उभौ //
text_mt:
named Sumukha. Taking both [him and his mother?], they went
to Śakra among the serpents, and then both of them made a request to Śakra.

sanskrit_iast:
sumukhasyābhayaṃ tārkṣyāt tayoḥ śakro dadau varam
vīryajñas tārkṣyavīryasya sa yayau keśavāntikam //
meaning:
सुमुखस्याभयं तार्क्ष्यात् तयोः शक्रो ददौ वरम्
वीर्यज्ञस् तार्क्ष्यवीर्यस्य स ययौ केशवान्तिकम् //
text_mt:
Śakra granted a boon to the two: safety for Sumukha from Tārkṣya.
Knowing the prowess of Tārkṣya, he [Śakra] went to Keśava's presence.

sanskrit_iast:
sumukhasyābhayaṃ prādāt tārkṣyam madhuniṣūdanaḥ
ājagāma tatas tārkṣyaḥ saroṣaḥ keśavāntikam //
meaning:
सुमुखस्याभयं प्रादात् तार्क्ष्यम् मधुनिषूदनः
आजगाम ततस् तार्क्ष्यः सरोषः केशवान्तिकम् //
text_mt:
The slayer of Madhu granted safety to Sumukha from Tārkṣya.
Then Tārkṣya arrived in fury before Keśava.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍa uvāca
kim avajñāya māṃ kṛṣṇa sumukhe dīyate varaḥ
mama pṛṣṭhagataḥ śatruṃs tvaṃ nihaṃsi ca buddhyase
kuṭumbābharaṇaṃ śatruṃ pannagaṃ mama rakṣasi //
meaning:
गरुड उवाच
किम् अवज्ञाय मां कृष्ण सुमुखे दीयते वरः
मम पृष्ठगतः शत्रुंस् त्वं निहंसि च बुद्ध्यसे
कुटुम्बाभरणं शत्रुं पन्नगं मम रक्षसि //
text_mt:
Garuḍa said:
Why, having disregarded me, O Kṛṣṇa, is a boon granted to Sumukha?
Mounted on my back, you slay enemies and are glorified,
[yet] you protect my enemy, a serpent, who is nourishment for my family!

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evam uktas tadā tena viṣṇur garuḍam abravīt //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवम् उक्तस् तदा तेन विष्णुर् गरुडम् अब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed then by him, Viṣṇu said to Garuḍa:

sanskrit_iast:
[viṣṇu:]
na me śakto jagad voḍhuṃ sakalaṃ vihageśvara
aham evātmanātmānaṃ dhārayāmi raṇeraṇe //
meaning:
[विष्णु:]
न मे शक्तो जगद् वोढुं सकलं विहगेश्वर
अहम् एवात्मनात्मानं धारयामि रणेरणे //
text_mt:
[Viṣṇu:]
'O lord of birds, you are not capable of bearing my entire world.
I myself bear myself by myself in battle after battle.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiś ced asti voḍhuṃ te bhujam ekaṃ vahasva me
evam uktvā dadau pṛṣṭhe tasya savyaṃ bhujaṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
शक्तिश् चेद् अस्ति वोढुं ते भुजम् एकं वहस्व मे
एवम् उक्त्वा ददौ पृष्ठे तस्य सव्यं भुजं हरिः //
text_mt:
If you have the strength to bear [me], carry just one arm of mine.'
Having spoken thus, Hari placed his left arm upon his back.

sanskrit_iast:
tato viṣaṇṇavadanaḥ pakṣatyāgāt khagottamaḥ
klānto dīnaś ca tuṣṭāva deveśaṃ madhusūdanam //
meaning:
ततो विषण्णवदनः पक्षत्यागात् खगोत्तमः
क्लान्तो दीनश् च तुष्टाव देवेशं मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt:
Then, his face dejected, losing his wings,
the best of birds, exhausted and miserable, praised Madhusūdana, the lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍa uvāca
namas te devadeveśa surāsuranamaskṛta
ajeya puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgatavatsala //
meaning:
गरुड उवाच
नमस् ते देवदेवेश सुरासुरनमस्कृत
अजेय पुण्डरीकाक्ष शरणागतवत्सल //
text_mt:
Garuḍa said:
Salutations to you, O lord of the gods of gods, revered by gods and demons!
O unconquerable one, O Puṇḍarīkākṣa, O affectionate to those who have come for refuge!

sanskrit_iast:
na mayā tvadbalaṃ jñātam ātmasaṃbhāvitātmanā
tvam eva deva trailokyaṃ sadā dhārayase 'nagha //
meaning:
न मया त्वद्बलं ज्ञातम् आत्मसंभावितात्मना
त्वम् एव देव त्रैलोक्यं सदा धारयसे ऽनघ //
text_mt:
Your strength was not known by me, whose mind was full of self-conceit.
You alone, O sinless god, continually bear the three worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānam ātmanā deva tvam eva vahase sadā
yasya te deva sakalaṃ dehe tribhuvanaṃ sthitam //
meaning:
आत्मानम् आत्मना देव त्वम् एव वहसे सदा
यस्य ते देव सकलं देहे त्रिभुवनं स्थितम् //
text_mt:
O god, you alone always bear yourself by yourself;
for the entire three worlds reside in your body, O god!

sanskrit_iast:
tasya voḍhuṃ kathaṃ śaktā madvidhā hi sahasraśaḥ
tasmāt prasīda bhagavan mama dhvajanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
तस्य वोढुं कथं शक्ता मद्विधा हि सहस्रशः
तस्मात् प्रसीद भगवन् मम ध्वजनिवासिनः //
text_mt:
How are thousands like me capable of bearing you?
Therefore, be gracious, O Lord, to me who reside on your banner!

sanskrit_iast:
nāsty antas tava deveśa karmaṇāṃ bhuvanatraye
kas te kīrtayituṃ śaktaḥ karmāṇy anavaśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
नास्त्य् अन्तस् तव देवेश कर्मणां भुवनत्रये
कस् ते कीर्तयितुं शक्तः कर्माण्य् अनवशेषतः //
text_mt:
There is no end, O lord of gods, to your deeds in the three worlds.
Who is capable of proclaiming your deeds without remainder?

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇāṃ kīrtanaṃ vā te kā stutiḥ parameśvara
sarvatra sarvaśaktis tvaṃ prasīda mama śatruhan //
meaning:
कर्मणां कीर्तनं वा ते का स्तुतिः परमेश्वर
सर्वत्र सर्वशक्तिस् त्वं प्रसीद मम शत्रुहन् //
text_mt:
Or what praise is there in the recitation of your deeds, O supreme Lord?
You are omnipotent everywhere; be gracious to me, O slayer of foes!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtakṛtāvāsa vāsudeva jagatpate
kalpāntāmbhodhiśayana nārāyaṇa mahādyute //
meaning:
सर्वभूतकृतावास वासुदेव जगत्पते
कल्पान्ताम्भोधिशयन नारायण महाद्युते //
text_mt:
O you who dwell in all beings, O Vāsudeva, O Lord of the world!
O you who recline on the ocean at the end of the aeon, O Nārāyaṇa of great splendour!

sanskrit_iast:
nābhīkamalakiñjalkapiñjarīkṛtavigraha
prasīda me namas te 'stu pakṣiṇo dhvajavāsinaḥ //
meaning:
नाभीकमलकिञ्जल्कपिञ्जरीकृतविग्रह
प्रसीद मे नमस् ते ऽस्तु पक्षिणो ध्वजवासिनः //
text_mt:
O you whose body is made yellow by the filaments of the lotus from your navel!
Be gracious to me, salutations to you, [from] the bird who resides on your banner!'

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhagavān uvāca
ātmasaṃbhāvanā tārkṣya na kāryā te kadācana
aham evātmanātmānaṃ vahāmi tvāṃ ca dhāraye //
meaning:
श्रीभगवान् उवाच
आत्मसंभावना तार्क्ष्य न कार्या ते कदाचन
अहम् एवात्मनात्मानं वहामि त्वां च धारये //
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
'Self-conceit should never be harboured by you, O Tārkṣya.
I myself bear myself by myself, and I sustain you as well.

sanskrit_iast:
prītā na ca tvayā bhāryā yad apakṣaḥ kṛto hy asi
mayā tribhuvanaṃ nyastaṃ tvadartham akhilaṃ bhuje //
meaning:
प्रीता न च त्वया भार्या यद् अपक्षः कृतो ह्य् असि
मया त्रिभुवनं न्यस्तं त्वदर्थम् अखिलं भुजे //
text_mt:
[…] because you have been made wingless;
for your sake the entire three worlds were placed by me on my arm.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā tulyo hi balavāṃl loke 'nyo nāsti kaścana
yasya dordaṇḍasaṃsparśāj jīvitaṃ na ca nirgatam //
meaning:
त्वया तुल्यो हि बलवांल् लोके ऽन्यो नास्ति कश्चन
यस्य दोर्दण्डसंस्पर्शाज् जीवितं न च निर्गतम् //
text_mt:
For no one else in the world is as strong as you,
from contact with whose staff-like arm life has not departed.

sanskrit_iast:
yadvaś(?)śarīrajo bhūtvā balavān khagasattama
viśeṣavantaḥ pakṣānte bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यद्वश्(?)शरीरजो भूत्वा बलवान् खगसत्तम
विशेषवन्तः पक्षान्ते भविष्यन्ति न संशयः //
text_mt:
[…] born from my body, mighty, O best of birds,
[your wings] will undoubtedly become endowed with excellence at the end of the fortnight.'

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evam uktaḥ suparṇas tu suparṇān prāptavān punaḥ
tejobalādhikatvaṃ vā lebhe devaprasādataḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवम् उक्तः सुपर्णस् तु सुपर्णान् प्राप्तवान् पुनः
तेजोबलाधिकत्वं वा लेभे देवप्रसादतः //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus addressed, the fair-winged one regained his beautiful wings,
or rather obtained an increase of splendour and strength by the grace of the god.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ puruṣavat tārkṣyaḥ stūyamānaś ca śārṅgiṇam
bhūya eva suparṇa(t)tvaṃ gamito 'tibalaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एवं पुरुषवत् तार्क्ष्यः स्तूयमानश् च शार्ङ्गिणम्
भूय एव सुपर्ण(त्)त्वं गमितो ऽतिबलः कृतः //
text_mt:
Thus Tārkṣya, who was praising the wielder of the Śārṅga bow like a man,
was once again restored to being fair-winged and made exceedingly strong.

sanskrit_iast:
śakrayācitamātreṇa sumukho 'py amaraḥ kṛtaḥ
tasmād rājan vijānīhi tasya dānavavidviṣaḥ //
meaning:
शक्रयाचितमात्रेण सुमुखो ऽप्य् अमरः कृतः
तस्माद् राजन् विजानीहि तस्य दानवविद्विषः //
text_mt:
Merely upon being requested by Śakra, Sumukha too was made immortal.
Therefore, O king, know concerning that enemy of the Dānavas:

sanskrit_iast:
nāsty adeyaṃ hi bhakteṣu devarājyam api dhruvam
mṛtyupāśagṛhītānāṃ patanān(?) narake tathā
smṛtamātraḥ sa deveśas tadbhayād vinivartakaḥ //
meaning:
नास्त्य् अदेयं हि भक्तेषु देवराज्यम् अपि ध्रुवम्
मृत्युपाशगृहीतानां पतनान्(?) नरके तथा
स्मृतमात्रः स देवेशस् तद्भयाद् विनिवर्तकः //

sanskrit_iast:
nihatasakaladuḥkho bhaktibhājāṃ narāṇāṃ dvijavibudhavarāṇāṃ pūjanīyo 'rihantā
khagapanṛpatiyāyī vīrasaṃjātavarṇo bhavatu madhuripus te bhaktinamrasya tuṣṭaḥ //
meaning:
निहतसकलदुःखो भक्तिभाजां नराणां द्विजविबुधवराणां पूजनीयो ऽरिहन्ता
खगपनृपतियायी वीरसंजातवर्णो भवतु मधुरिपुस् ते भक्तिनम्रस्य तुष्टः //
text_mt:
May the enemy of Madhu—who destroys all suffering of men possessing devotion, who is worthy of worship by the foremost of twice-born and deities, who slays adversaries,
who rides upon the king of birds, whose praises are sung by heroes—be pleased with you who are bowed in devotion!

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca
śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ tvattaḥ prasādaṃ paramaṃ hi yat
kṛtaṃ bhaktajane tena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā //
meaning:
वज्र उवाच
श्रोतुम् इच्छाम्य् अहं त्वत्तः प्रसादं परमं हि यत्
कृतं भक्तजने तेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना //
text_mt:
Vajra said:
I wish to hear from you that supreme grace
which was bestowed upon his devoted people by that powerful Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
hate tribhuvane rājañ śakrasya balinā purā
jagāma śakraḥ śaraṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ pitaraṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
हते त्रिभुवने राजञ् शक्रस्य बलिना पुरा
जगाम शक्रः शरणं कश्यपं पितरं ततः //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Formerly, O king, when the three worlds of Śakra were seized by Bali,
Śakra then went for refuge to his father Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
kaśyapaḥ śakram ādāya jagāmātha pitāmaham
tam āha varado brahmā gaccha kaśyapa keśavam //
meaning:
कश्यपः शक्रम् आदाय जगामाथ पितामहम्
तम् आह वरदो ब्रह्मा गच्छ कश्यप केशवम् //
text_mt:
Taking Śakra with him, Kaśyapa then went to the Grandfather [Brahmā].
Boon-granting Brahmā said to him: 'Go, Kaśyapa, to Keśava,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ devaṃ śaraṇaṃ madhusūdanam
taṃ ca prārthaya putratve sa te putro bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
क्षीरोदशायिनं देवं शरणं मधुसूदनम्
तं च प्रार्थय पुत्रत्वे स ते पुत्रो भविष्यति //
text_mt:
for refuge to the god who reclines on the Milky Ocean, Madhusūdana;
and pray to him for sonship: he will become your son.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ devarājasya dāsyati
evaṃ coktaḥ kaśyapas tu sārdhaṃ tridaśapuṅgavaiḥ //
meaning:
ततः स सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं देवराजस्य दास्यति
एवं चोक्तः कश्यपस् तु सार्धं त्रिदशपुङ्गवैः //
text_mt: "Then he will give all the three worlds to the king of the gods." / Thus addressed, Kaśyapa went, accompanied by the foremost of the thirty [gods],

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīrābdhiṃ sa tato gatvā dadarśa tapasā harim
dṛṣṭvā stavena tuṣṭāva tatas tasya tadā hariḥ //
meaning:
क्षीराब्धिं स ततो गत्वा ददर्श तपसा हरिम्
दृष्ट्वा स्तवेन तुष्टाव ततस् तस्य तदा हरिः //
text_mt: To the Ocean of Milk, and there beheld Hari through ascetic penance. / Having seen him, he praised him with a hymn of praise. Thereupon Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
prasannaḥ putratām etya devo vāmanarūpadhṛk
tribhir natais tribhuvanaṃ sarvam ākramya viśvadhṛk //
meaning:
प्रसन्नः पुत्रताम् एत्य देवो वामनरूपधृक्
त्रिभिर् नतैस् त्रिभुवनं सर्वम् आक्रम्य विश्वधृक् //
text_mt: Pleased with him, became his son, the god assuming the form of the Dwarf. / Striding across all the three worlds with three strides, the sustainer of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
prādāc chakrāya rājendra baddhvā daityeśvaraṃ balim
kaśyapena stutas tv evaṃ tasya putratvam āgataḥ //
meaning:
प्रादाच् छक्राय राजेन्द्र बद्ध्वा दैत्येश्वरं बलिम्
कश्यपेन स्तुतस् त्व् एवं तस्य पुत्रत्वम् आगतः //
text_mt: Bound Bali, the lord of the Daityas, and gave [the realm] to Śakra, O best of kings. / Thus praised by Kaśyapa, he had become his son.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca
stavena yena tuṣṭāva kaśyapo madhusūdanam
taṃ stavaṃ tvaṃ samācakṣva sarvapāpaharaṃ śivam //
meaning:
वज्र उवाच
स्तवेन येन तुष्टाव कश्यपो मधुसूदनम्
तं स्तवं त्वं समाचक्ष्व सर्वपापहरं शिवम् //
text_mt: Vajra said: / Tell me that auspicious hymn of praise, destroying all sins, / with which Kaśyapa praised Madhusūdana.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
śṛṇu rājan stavaṃ puṇyaṃ kaśyapena prakīrtitam
kṣīrodaśayanād dṛṣṭvā devadevaṃ samutthitam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
शृणु राजन् स्तवं पुण्यं कश्यपेन प्रकीर्तितम्
क्षीरोदशयनाद् दृष्ट्वा देवदेवं समुत्थितम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hear, O king, the sacred hymn of praise proclaimed by Kaśyapa / upon seeing the God of gods arise from his bed on the Kṣīroda ocean.

text_mt: Kaśyapa said: / Oṃ, homage to you, O God of gods! / Single-horned one! / Honored by the righteous! / Tree of the ocean! / Vṛṣākapi! / Protector of the gods! / Blameless one! / Auspicious one! / Kapila! / Viṣvaksena! / Steadfast one! / Dharma! / Having dharma for your banner! / Vaikuṇṭha! / Source of righteousness! / Devoid of beginning, middle, or end! / Dear to the people! / Born of the Vṛṣṇis! / Lying in nectar! / Eternal one! / Possessing three abodes! / Threefold abode! / Tuṣita! / Dundubhi! / World of the great! / Navel of the world! / Lotus-navelled one! / Viriñca! / Multiform one! / Imperishable in an instant! / Eater of the sacrificial offering! / Having a broken axe! / Discus! / Shaven-headed one! / Swan! / Generous giver of sacrificial gifts! / Hṛṣīkeśa! / Subtle one! / Multitude of great sages! / Free from passion and darkness! / Foundation of all the worlds! / Śipiviṣṭa! / Incorporeal! / First-born! / Born of dharma! / Dharma-navelled one! / Having rays for your navel! / Having the moon for a chariot! / Free from sin! / You alone! / Dweller in the ocean! / Unborn one! / Single-footed! / Supported by thousands! / Great-headed! / Thousand-sighted! / Thousand-footed! / Iron-faced! / Great Spirit! / Thousand-armed! / Thousand-formed! / Thousand-eyed! / Source of thousands! / In thousands the knowers of the Veda proclaim you, who know the Veda! / They declare the universe-hood of all [to be you]! / Flower-smile! / Supreme wanderer, you indeed are Vauṣaṭ! / Vaṣaṭkāra! / Svāhā! Consuming the portion in sacrifices, hundred-streamed and thousand-streamed! / You indeed are Bhūr or Bhuvar! / Composed of the Brahman! / Of the line of the Brahmā! / Brahmā! / You are the directions! / You are heaven! / You are earth! / You are Mātariśvan! / The Hotṛ! / The Potṛ! / The Thinker! / The Leader! / You alone are the foremost cause of offering! / Through the universal abode, you alone! / Adorned with garlands by the quarters, you are the object of sacrifice! / Samādhā! / Semindhi! / You are the refuge of the wise! / You are Yoga! / You are liberation! / You are the supreme! / You are the offering ladle! / You are the creator! / You are sacrifice! / You are Soma! / You are smoke! / You are initiation! / You are the sacrificial fee! / You are the universe! / Ancient one! / Overcoming the mighty! / Hiraṇyagarbha! / Nārāyaṇa! / Endless one! / Vṛṇasame! / Having the color of the sun! / Having the splendour of the sun! / Great Spirit! / Puruṣottama! / Primordial God! / Lotus-navelled one! / Lotus-smiling one! / Lotus-lying one! / Lotus-eyed one! / Golden-haired at the tip! / White one! / Universal Self! / God of the universe! / Facing all directions! / Named after the universe! / Origin of the universe! / Eater of the universe, you alone are the earth-strider, transcending the world, creator of light, Śambhu, self-born of the atmosphere! / Origin of beings! / Great element! / Pervading the universe! / You are the universe itself! / You are the protector of the universe! / You are the purifier! / The oblation! / Creator of the universe! / Of upward actions! / Foremost of immortality! / Protector of the atmosphere! / Anointed with ghee! / Agni! / Druhiṇa! / Of infinite deeds! / Leading subjugation! / Having universal sides! / Flank! / You alone are the universe! Protect those who seek boons!

vajra uvāca
prasādaṃ paramaṃ tasya keśavasya mahātmanaḥ
brūhi bhaktajane mahyaṃ devadevasya cakriṇaḥ //
meaning:
वज्र उवाच
प्रसादं परमं तस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः
ब्रूहि भक्तजने मह्यं देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः //
text_mt: Vajra said: / Declare to me, who am a devoted person, the supreme grace / of that high-souled Keśava, the God of gods, bearer of the discus.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi tṛpyāmy ahaṃ tasya śṛṇvānaḥ śravaṇāmṛtam
hastatrāṇaprado loke ya ekaḥ patatāṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
न हि तृप्याम्य् अहं तस्य शृण्वानः श्रवणामृतम्
हस्तत्राणप्रदो लोके य एकः पततां नृणाम् //
text_mt: For I am not satiated hearing the nectar for the ears of him / who alone in this world gives a helping hand to falling men.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
devāś ca ṛṣayaś caiva vivadantaḥ purānagha
bījair yaṣṭavyam ity etat trivarṣaparamoṣitaiḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
देवाश् च ऋषयश् चैव विवदन्तः पुरानघ
बीजैर् यष्टव्यम् इत्य् एतत् त्रिवर्षपरमोषितैः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Formerly, O sinless one, the gods and the sages debated: / "Sacrifice must be performed with seeds stored for a maximum of three years.

sanskrit_iast:
ajasaṃjñāni bījāni chāgaṃ ghnantum athārhasi
pakṣo 'yam āsīd dharmajña ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām //
meaning:
अजसंज्ञानि बीजानि छागं घ्नन्तुम् अथार्हसि
पक्षो ऽयम् आसीद् धर्मज्ञ ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् //
text_mt: Seeds are designated as 'aja'; you ought not to kill a goat." / This, O knower of dharma, was the view of the sages of purified mind.

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ tu paśuḥ pakṣas tato mārgāgato [']bhavat
rājoparicaro nāma vasur vasumatāṃ varaḥ //
meaning:
देवानां तु पशुः पक्षस् ततो मार्गागतो [']भवत्
राजोपरिचरो नाम वसुर् वसुमतां वरः //
text_mt: The view of the gods, however, was [sacrifice by] an animal. Then, passing on the way, / there was the king named Uparicara Vasu, the foremost of the opulent.

sanskrit_iast:
devāś ca ṛṣayaś caiva papṛcchantas tadā vasum
yathopanītair yaṣṭavyam ity uktaṃ vasunā purā //
meaning:
देवाश् च ऋषयश् चैव पपृच्छन्तस् तदा वसुम्
यथोपनीतैर् यष्टव्यम् इत्य् उक्तं वसुना पुरा //
text_mt: Then the gods and the sages questioned Vasu. / "Sacrifice must be performed with what is presented," was formerly said by Vasu.

sanskrit_iast:
gatenānṛtavākyena rājā hiṃsāpravartinā
nityamākāśago bhūtvā bhūmer vivarago [']bhavat //
meaning:
गतेनानृतवाक्येन राजा हिंसाप्रवर्तिना
नित्यमाकाशगो भूत्वा भूमेर् विवरगो [']भवत् //
text_mt: Because of that false statement promoting violence, the king, / who had always moved in the sky, fell into a fissure in the earth.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmer vivaragasyātha devapakṣārthavādinaḥ
nidhanārthaṃ matiṃ cakrur devabhaktasya dānavāḥ //
meaning:
भूमेर् विवरगस्याथ देवपक्षार्थवादिनः
निधनार्थं मतिं चक्रुर् देवभक्तस्य दानवाः //
text_mt: When he was dwelling in the fissure of the earth, having argued in favor of the gods, / the Dānavas resolved to destroy him, devoted as he was to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ cikīrṣitaṃ śrutvā devāḥ śīghraparākramāḥ
nyavedayaṃs tathā cakraṃ devācārye bṛhaspatau //
meaning:
तेषां चिकीर्षितं श्रुत्वा देवाः शीघ्रपराक्रमाः
न्यवेदयंस् तथा चक्रं देवाचार्ये बृहस्पतौ //
text_mt: Hearing what they intended to do, the swift-valiant gods / likewise made an arrangement with Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatis tato gatvā bhūmer vivaragaṃ nṛpam
rakṣām adhyāpayām āsa vaiṣṇavīm aparājitām //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिस् ततो गत्वा भूमेर् विवरगं नृपम्
रक्षाम् अध्यापयाम् आस वैष्णवीम् अपराजिताम् //
text_mt: Then Bṛhaspati, going to the king dwelling in the fissure of the earth, / instructed him in the invincible protective spell of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyāṇāṃ karmaṇām anukīrtanaiḥ
nirmitā brahmaṇā vidyā sarvabādhākṣayaṃkarī
adhyāpya taṃ ca rājānam idam āha bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
भूतभव्यभविष्याणां कर्मणाम् अनुकीर्तनैः
निर्मिता ब्रह्मणा विद्या सर्वबाधाक्षयंकरी
अध्याप्य तं च राजानम् इदम् आह बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: Fashioned by Brahmā to destroy all obstacles, / through the commemoration of past, present, and future deeds. / Having instructed the king, Bṛhaspati spoke these words:

sanskrit_iast:
bṛhaspatir uvāca
ihastho bhokṣyase rājan vasor dhārāṃ hutāṃ dvijaiḥ
devatānāṃ prasādena tayā cāpyāyitaḥ sadā //
meaning:
बृहस्पतिर् उवाच
इहस्थो भोक्ष्यसे राजन् वसोर् धारां हुतां द्विजैः
देवतानां प्रसादेन तया चाप्यायितः सदा //
text_mt: Bṛhaspati said: / Staying here, O king, you will consume the continuous stream of ghee poured out by the Brahmins, / and, by the grace of the deities, you will always be invigorated by it.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyayā cānayā rājann avadhyas tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi
bhūmer vivarasaṃstho 'pi daityadānavarākṣasān
evam uktvā sa rājānaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata //
meaning:
विद्यया चानया राजन्न् अवध्यस् त्वं भविष्यसि
भूमेर् विवरसंस्थो ऽपि दैत्यदानवराक्षसान्
एवम् उक्त्वा स राजानं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत //
text_mt: And through this protective spell, O king, you will be invulnerable / to the Daityas, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas, even though situated in the earth's fissure. / Having spoken thus to the king, he vanished right there.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca
rakṣāṃ tu tāṃ me kathaya dvijendra kṛtā tu yā devapurohitena
rājño vasor bhūmibilasthitasya rakṣā hi sāgryā paramā matā me //
meaning:
वज्र उवाच
रक्षां तु तां मे कथय द्विजेन्द्र कृता तु या देवपुरोहितेन
राज्ञो वसोर् भूमिबिलस्थितस्य रक्षा हि साग्र्या परमा मता मे //
text_mt: Vajra said: / Tell me that protective spell, O foremost of Brahmins, which was composed by the family priest of the gods / for King Vasu who was situated in the hole of the earth; for I consider that protective spell to be the foremost and supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāḥ praṇaśyate puṣpaṃ garbho vā patate yadi
mriyante bālakā yasyāḥ kākavandhyā ca yā bhavet //
meaning:
यस्याः प्रणश्यते पुष्पं गर्भो वा पतते यदि
म्रियन्ते बालका यस्याः काकवन्ध्या च या भवेत् //

sanskrit_iast:

gulmaśūlākṣirogāṇāṃ kṣipraṃ nāśayati vyathām
śirorogajvarāṇāṃ ca nāśanī sarvadehinām //
