sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evaṃ hi kṛtarakṣasya vasudhārām upāśnataḥ
vasor vasumatīgarte tiṣṭhato danunandanāḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवं हि कृतरक्षस्य वसुधाराम् उपाश्नतः
वसोर् वसुमतीगर्ते तिष्ठतो दनुनन्दनाः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / While Vasu, having thus secured protection and partaking of the flow of wealth, remained in the cavity of the earth, the sons of Danu,

sanskrit_iast:
ajagmur vividhākārāś caturaṅgabalānvitāḥ
nānāpraharaṇā dagdhā bhīmavācaḥ sadāruṇāḥ //
meaning:
अजग्मुर् विविधाकाराश् चतुरङ्गबलान्विताः
नानाप्रहरणा दग्धा भीमवाचः सदारुणाः //
text_mt: possessing various forms, equipped with a fourfold army, / wielding diverse weapons, burnt [with fury], of terrible speech, and always cruel, arrived.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamya vāgbhir ugrābhis tarjayantaś ca te vasum
nirjaghnur āyudhair bhīmair devapakṣaparaṃ sadā //
meaning:
आगम्य वाग्भिर् उग्राभिस् तर्जयन्तश् च ते वसुम्
निर्जघ्नुर् आयुधैर् भीमैर् देवपक्षपरं सदा //
text_mt: Having arrived and threatening Vasu with fierce words, / they struck with terrible weapons at him who was ever devoted to the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
na ca te 'sya rujaṃ cakrur na ca tān apy udīkṣitā
cintayām āsa deveśaṃ manasā madhusūdanam //
meaning:
न च ते ऽस्य रुजं चक्रुर् न च तान् अप्य् उदीक्षिता
चिन्तयाम् आस देवेशं मनसा मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: Yet they caused him no injury, nor did he even look up at them; / with his mind he meditated upon Madhusūdana, the lord of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
tato niṣphalayatnās te dṛṣṭvā tan mahad adbhutam
jagmuḥ sarve gṛhān eva vilakṣā daityadānavāḥ //
meaning:
ततो निष्फलयत्नास् ते दृष्ट्वा तन् महद् अद्भुतम्
जग्मुः सर्वे गृहान् एव विलक्षा दैत्यदानवाः //
text_mt: Then, their efforts proving fruitless, having seen that great marvel, / all the Daityas and Dānavas departed for their homes in disappointment.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu niṣphalayatneṣu devo garuḍam abravīt
gatvā garuḍa rājānam vasuṃ śīghram ihānaya //
meaning:
तेषु निष्फलयत्नेषु देवो गरुडम् अब्रवीत्
गत्वा गरुड राजानम् वसुं शीघ्रम् इहानय //
text_mt: When their efforts had proved fruitless, the Lord said to Garuḍa: / “Go, Garuḍa, and quickly bring King Vasu here.”

sanskrit_iast:
evam uktaḥ sa garuḍo devadevena cakriṇā
pakṣavātārṇavakṣobha(?)kṣubdhayādogaṇo yayau //
meaning:
एवम् उक्तः स गरुडो देवदेवेन चक्रिणा
पक्षवातार्णवक्षोभ(?)क्षुब्धयादोगणो ययौ //
text_mt: Thus spoken to by the god of gods, the wielder of the discus, / Garuḍa set out, agitating the aquatic creatures through the ocean's commotion caused by the wind of his wings.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa ca bhuvo garte dhyānasaṃmīlitekṣaṇam
vasurājo 'pi garuḍaṃ dadarśa harivāhanam //
meaning:
ददर्श च भुवो गर्ते ध्यानसंमीलितेक्षणम्
वसुराजो ऽपि गरुडं ददर्श हरिवाहनम् //
text_mt: And he saw him in the pit of the earth, his eyes closed in meditation; / King Vasu also saw Garuḍa, the mount of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā garuḍaṃ prāptaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitam
tuṣṭāva garuḍaṃ vāgbhir arthyābhir amitakriyaḥ //
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा गरुडं प्राप्तं कृष्णभक्तिसमन्वितम्
तुष्टाव गरुडं वाग्भिर् अर्थ्याभिर् अमितक्रियः //
text_mt: Having seen Garuḍa arrived, full of devotion to Kṛṣṇa, / he of boundless deeds praised Garuḍa with meaningful words.

sanskrit_iast:
vasur uvāca
namasyāmi mahābāhuṃ khagendraṃ harivāhanam
viṣṇor dhvajāgrasaṃsthāna vitrāsitamahāsura //
meaning:
वसुर् उवाच
नमस्यामि महाबाहुं खगेन्द्रं हरिवाहनम्
विष्णोर् ध्वजाग्रसंस्थान वित्रासितमहासुर //
text_mt: Vasu said: / I bow to the mighty-armed king of birds, the mount of Hari, / stationed at the tip of Viṣṇu's banner, the terrifier of great Asuras!

sanskrit_iast:
namas te nāgadarpaghna vinatānandavardhana
svapakṣavātanirdhūtadīnadaityanirīkṣita //
meaning:
नमस् ते नागदर्पघ्न विनतानन्दवर्धन
स्वपक्षवातनिर्धूतदीनदैत्यनिरीक्षित //
text_mt: Homage to you, slayer of the serpent's pride, increaser of Vinatā's joy, / who are beheld by the wretched Daityas shaken by the wind of your own wings!

sanskrit_iast:
parasparasya śāpena supratīka vibhāvaso
gajakacchapatāṃ prāptau tāv ubhau vairasaṃyutau //
meaning:
परस्परस्य शापेन सुप्रतीक विभावसो
गजकच्छपतां प्राप्तौ ताव् उभौ वैरसंयुतौ //
text_mt: By mutual curse, Supratīka and Vibhāvasu / were turned into an elephant and a tortoise, both filled with enmity.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍ ucchrito yojanāni gajas taddviguṇāyataḥ
kūrmas triyojanotsedho daśayojanamaṇḍalaḥ //
meaning:
षड् उच्छ्रितो योजनानि गजस् तद्द्विगुणायतः
कूर्मस् त्रियोजनोत्सेधो दशयोजनमण्डलः //
text_mt: The elephant was six yojanas high and twice as long; / the tortoise was three yojanas in height and ten yojanas in circumference.

sanskrit_iast:
nakhasthau tau tvayā nītau hatau bhuktau ca pakṣipa
parasparakṛtocchrāyau dvārau ca parimokṣitau //
meaning:
नखस्थौ तौ त्वया नीतौ हतौ भुक्तौ च पक्षिप
परस्परकृतोच्छ्रायौ द्वारौ च परिमोक्षितौ //
text_mt: Held in your talons, both were carried off, slain, and eaten by you, O lord of birds; / both of them, who had raised themselves against each other, were thus released.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣādaviṣayaṃ bhuktaṃ tatra krūram aninditam
niṣādīśastato (?) muktas tatrāpi brāhmaṇas tvayā //
meaning:
निषादविषयं भुक्तं तत्र क्रूरम् अनिन्दितम्
निषादीशस्ततो (?) मुक्तस् तत्रापि ब्राह्मणस् त्वया //
text_mt: The region of the Niṣādas was devoured—the cruel, blameless one there; / and the lord of the Niṣādas was spared, and the brāhmaṇa there was released by you.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā rohiṇivṛkṣasya yojanānāṃ śātāyatā
śākhā bhinnāḥ sthitā yatra vālakhilyāḥ sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
त्वया रोहिणिवृक्षस्य योजनानां शातायता
शाखा भिन्नाः स्थिता यत्र वालखिल्याः सहस्रशः //
text_mt: By you a branch of the Rohiṇa tree, a hundred yojanas long, / was broken, upon which thousands of Vālakhilyas were hanging.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃs tu vaktragatān kṛtvā nakhasthair gajakacchapaiḥ
nabhasy eva nirālambe sarvataḥ parivāritaḥ //
meaning:
तांस् तु वक्त्रगतान् कृत्वा नखस्थैर् गजकच्छपैः
नभस्य् एव निरालम्बे सर्वतः परिवारितः //
text_mt: Taking it in your beak while holding the elephant and tortoise in your talons, / you were surrounded on all sides in the unsupported sky.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā jitvā raṇe sarvān devāñ śakrapurogamān
āhṛtaṃ tu paraṃ somaṃ vahner vāpy atha kāśyapa //
meaning:
त्वया जित्वा रणे सर्वान् देवाञ् शक्रपुरोगमान्
आहृतं तु परं सोमं वह्नेर् वाप्य् अथ काश्यप //
text_mt: Having conquered in battle all the gods headed by Śakra, / the supreme soma was brought away by you from the fire, O son of Kaśyapa!

sanskrit_iast:
nāgau dṛṣṭiviṣau kṛtvā rajasā bhuvi cakṣuṣoḥ
jihvāgranityagaṃ bhuñjañ cakre tau devanirmitau //
meaning:
नागौ दृष्टिविषौ कृत्वा रजसा भुवि चक्षुषोः
जिह्वाग्रनित्यगं भुञ्जञ् चक्रे तौ देवनिर्मितौ //
text_mt: Making the two venomous-eyed serpents blind with dust on the earth, / you consumed them as they hovered at the tip of your tongue, and made them fashioned by the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
āhṛtyāpi tvayā somaṃ nītam eva na bhakṣitam
tena viṣṇor dhvajasthāne vāhanatvaṃ gato hy asi //
meaning:
आहृत्यापि त्वया सोमं नीतम् एव न भक्षितम्
तेन विष्णोर् ध्वजस्थाने वाहनत्वं गतो ह्य् असि //
text_mt: Even after fetching the soma, it was only carried off by you and not consumed; / because of that, you attained the status of being Viṣṇu’s mount and banner emblem.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā nikṣipya darbheṣu somaṃ nāgāś ca vañcitāḥ
jahāra sahasā yatra tac chīghraṃ balasūdanaḥ //
meaning:
त्वया निक्षिप्य दर्भेषु सोमं नागाश् च वञ्चिताः
जहार सहसा यत्र तच् छीघ्रं बलसूदनः //
text_mt: By you placing the soma upon the darbha grasses, the serpents were deceived, / where the slayer of Bala quickly snatched it away.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra jihvā dvidhā bhūtā pannagānāṃ dvijottamāḥ
vinatā mocitā dāsyāt kaṭvā pūrvaṃ jitā paṇe //
meaning:
यत्र जिह्वा द्विधा भूता पन्नगानां द्विजोत्तमाः
विनता मोचिता दास्यात् कट्वा पूर्वं जिता पणे //
text_mt: Where the tongues of the serpents were split in two, O best among birds; / and Vinatā was freed from slavery to Kadrū, having previously been defeated in a wager.

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥśravās tu kiṃvarṇaḥ śukla ity eva bhāṣatī
kṛṣṇavālam ahaṃ manye pucchaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva vākchalāt //
meaning:
उच्चैःश्रवास् तु किंवर्णः शुक्ल इत्य् एव भाषती
कृष्णवालम् अहं मन्ये पुच्छं दृष्ट्वैव वाक्छलात् //
text_mt: When she asked, “What color is Uccaiḥśravas? He is white,” / saying, “I consider his tail to be black,” having seen the tail by deceit of words.

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā vajraprahāreṇa pakṣayuktaṃ purā svayam
dadhīcivajraśakrāṇāṃ mānanārthāya nānyathā //
meaning:
त्वया वज्रप्रहारेण पक्षयुक्तं पुरा स्वयम्
दधीचिवज्रशक्राणां माननार्थाय नान्यथा //
text_mt: Formerly, by you yourself a wing was cast off upon the stroke of the thunderbolt, / solely out of respect for Dadhīci, the thunderbolt, and Śakra, and not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pakṣasya devendro yadā nāntaṃ hi dṛṣṭavān
tadā tava suparṇeti nāma khyātaṃ jagattraye //
meaning:
तस्य पक्षस्य देवेन्द्रो यदा नान्तं हि दृष्टवान्
तदा तव सुपर्णेति नाम ख्यातं जगत्त्रये //
text_mt: When the king of the gods saw no end to that wing, / then your name Suparṇa became renowned in the three worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tejasā bhāskaraṃ devaṃ javena ca samīraṇam
na te tulyo mahābhāga nāgapakṣakṣayaṃkara //
meaning:
तेजसा भास्करं देवं जवेन च समीरणम्
न ते तुल्यो महाभाग नागपक्षक्षयंकर //
text_mt: In splendor you equal the sun deity, and in speed the wind; / there is no one equal to you, O highly fortunate one, destroyer of the serpent race!

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānamātre tvayi vibho viśvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
kṣipraṃ praṇāśam āyāti tathā sarvabhayāni ca //
meaning:
ध्यानमात्रे त्वयि विभो विश्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
क्षिप्रं प्रणाशम् आयाति तथा सर्वभयानि च //
text_mt: At the mere meditation upon you, O omnipresent lord, this whole universe / of the moving and unmoving, as well as all fears, quickly comes to destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
svakayā pakṣanāḍyā tvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ vahan
nopayāsi prabho khedaṃ yathā devo janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
स्वकया पक्षनाड्या त्वं ब्रह्माण्डं सकलं वहन्
नोपयासि प्रभो खेदं यथा देवो जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Bearing the entire egg of Brahmā upon the quill of your wing, / you do not experience exhaustion, O lord, just like the god Janārdana.

sanskrit_iast:
tvam ṛṣis tvaṃ mahābhāgas tvaṃ devaḥ patageśvaraḥ
tvaṃ prabhus tapanaprakhyas tvaṃ nas trāṇam anuttamam //
meaning:
त्वम् ऋषिस् त्वं महाभागस् त्वं देवः पतगेश्वरः
त्वं प्रभुस् तपनप्रख्यस् त्वं नस् त्राणम् अनुत्तमम् //
text_mt: You are a sage, you are highly fortunate, you are a god, the lord of birds; / you are the lord resembling the sun, you are our supreme protection.

sanskrit_iast:
balormimān sādhvaradīnasattvaḥ samṛddhimān duṣprasahas tvam eva
tapaḥ śrutaṃ sarvam ahīnakīrtir anāgatādīn viṣayāṃś ca vetsi //
meaning:
बलोर्मिमान् साध्वरदीनसत्त्वः समृद्धिमान् दुष्प्रसहस् त्वम् एव
तपः श्रुतं सर्वम् अहीनकीर्तिर् अनागतादीन् विषयांश् च वेत्सि //
text_mt: You possess surges of strength, a noble and generous disposition, prosperity, and are difficult to withstand; / you possess ascetic power and sacred learning, unflinching fame, and you know the realms of the future and beyond.

sanskrit_iast:
tvam uttamaḥ sarvam idaṃ carācaraṃ gabhastibhir bhānur ivāvabhāse
samākṣipan bhānusutaprabhāṃ muhus tvam antakaḥ sarvam idaṃ dhruvādhruva (?) //
meaning:
त्वम् उत्तमः सर्वम् इदं चराचरं गभस्तिभिर् भानुर् इवावभासे
समाक्षिपन् भानुसुतप्रभां मुहुस् त्वम् अन्तकः सर्वम् इदं ध्रुवाध्रुव (?) //
text_mt: You are supreme; like the sun with its rays, you illuminate all this moving and unmoving world; / constantly outshining the brilliance of the sun's son, you are the ender of all this, permanent and impermanent.

sanskrit_iast:
divākaraḥ parikramati yathā dahan prajās tathā dahasi hutāśanaprabha
bhayaṃkaraḥ pralaya ivāgnir utthito vināśayaty uragaparivartapāntakṛt (?) //
meaning:
दिवाकरः परिक्रमति यथा दहन् प्रजास् तथा दहसि हुताशनप्रभ
भयंकरः प्रलय इवाग्निर् उत्थितो विनाशयत्य् उरगपरिवर्तपान्तकृत् (?) //
text_mt: Just as the sun circles burning creatures, so do you burn, glowing like sacrificial fire; / like the dreadful fire arising at the dissolution of the world, destroying, you put an end to the multitude of serpents.

sanskrit_iast:
khageśvaraṃ śaraṇam upāgato 'smy ahaṃ mahaujasaṃ vitimirabhragocaram (?)
mahābalaṃ garuḍam upetya khecaraṃ mahaujasaṃ varadam ajeyam aklamam //
meaning:
खगेश्वरं शरणम् उपागतो ऽस्म्य् अहं महौजसं वितिमिरभ्रगोचरम् (?)
महाबलं गरुडम् उपेत्य खेचरं महौजसं वरदम् अजेयम् अक्लमम् //
text_mt: I have approached the lord of birds for refuge, him of great splendor, who traverses the dark clouds, / having approached the mighty Garuḍa, the sky-roamer of great splendor, the boon-giver, unconquerable and untiring.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
stutas tu garuḍo rājñā pṛṣṭhamāro 'py apārthivam
darśayām āsa devasya viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
स्तुतस् तु गरुडो राज्ञा पृष्ठमारो ऽप्य् अपार्थिवम्
दर्शयाम् आस देवस्य विष्णोर् अमिततेजसः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Praised by the king, Garuḍa, having taken the king upon his back, / presented him to the god Viṣṇu of boundless splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā devadeveśam praṇatārtivināśanam
tuṣṭāva bhaktyā rājendra deveśam aparājitam //
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशम् प्रणतार्तिविनाशनम्
तुष्टाव भक्त्या राजेन्द्र देवेशम् अपराजितम् //
text_mt: Seeing the Lord of the gods of gods, who destroys the distress of those bowed in homage, / the king of kings praised with devotion the undefeated Lord of the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
vasur uvāca
namas te puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgatavatsala
daityadānavadarpaghna praṇatārtivināśana //
meaning:
वसुर् उवाच
नमस् ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष शरणागतवत्सल
दैत्यदानवदर्पघ्न प्रणतार्तिविनाशन //
text_mt: Vasu said: / Homage to you, lotus-eyed Puṇḍarīkākṣa, affectionate toward those who seek refuge, / slayer of the pride of Daityas and Dānavas, destroyer of the distress of those bowed in homage!

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakāmada kāmaghna viśvayone jagatpate
mahāmūrtiniśotthasya tamasaḥ pravināśana //
meaning:
कामकामद कामघ्न विश्वयोने जगत्पते
महामूर्तिनिशोत्थस्य तमसः प्रविनाशन //
text_mt: Grantor of desires to those who desire, destroyer of desire, origin of the universe, lord of the world, / destroyer of darkness that arises from the night of the Great Form!

sanskrit_iast:
na te viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ
ādis tvaṃ sarvadharmāṇām ṛṣīṇāṃ ca jagadguro //
meaning:
न ते विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः
आदिस् त्वं सर्वधर्माणाम् ऋषीणां च जगद्गुरो //
text_mt: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great ṛṣis know your origin; / you are the beginning of all duties and of the ṛṣis, O teacher of the world!

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmas tvaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo mahadbhyaś ca mahattaraḥ
dūragas tvaṃ mahābhāga sarveṣām api cāgataḥ //
meaning:
सूक्ष्मस् त्वं सर्वभूतेभ्यो महद्भ्यश् च महत्तरः
दूरगस् त्वं महाभाग सर्वेषाम् अपि चागतः //
text_mt: You are subtler than all beings and greater than the great; / you are far away, O fortunate one, and yet present before all.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhūtāntarastho 'pi karmabhir na ca lipyase
aśarīraḥ śarīrasthaḥ sarvabhūteṣv avasthitaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वभूतान्तरस्थो ऽपि कर्मभिर् न च लिप्यसे
अशरीरः शरीरस्थः सर्वभूतेष्व् अवस्थितः //
text_mt: Although dwelling within all beings, you are not stained by actions; / bodiless, yet dwelling in the body, remaining in all beings.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣas tvaṃ tvam avyaktas tvam ātmā buddhir eva ca
mahābhūtāni bhagavas tvaṃ tathaivendriyāṇi ca //
meaning:
पुरुषस् त्वं त्वम् अव्यक्तस् त्वम् आत्मा बुद्धिर् एव च
महाभूतानि भगवस् त्वं तथैवेन्द्रियाणि च //
text_mt: You are the Puruṣa, you are the Unmanifest, you are the Self and the intellect; / you are the great elements, O Blessed One, and likewise the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
yogibhir mṛṣyase yogajñānajñeya purātana
ye tvāṃ bhajanti te yānti bhagavan paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
योगिभिर् मृष्यसे योगज्ञानज्ञेय पुरातन
ये त्वां भजन्ति ते यान्ति भगवन् परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: You are meditated upon by yogins, O ancient one who are to be known by the knowledge of yoga; / those who worship you, O Blessed One, attain the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
jayam anagham ajeyaṃ viśvagaṃ devadevaṃ tridaśaripuvināśe nityam udyuktaśaktim
dvijasuravaravandyaṃ nāśanaṃ kalmaṣāṇāṃ śaraṇam upagato 'haṃ vāsudevaṃ śaraṇyam //
meaning:
जयम् अनघम् अजेयं विश्वगं देवदेवं त्रिदशरिपुविनाशे नित्यम् उद्युक्तशक्तिम्
द्विजसुरवरवन्द्यं नाशनं कल्मषाणां शरणम् उपगतो ऽहं वासुदेवं शरण्यम् //
text_mt: I have taken refuge in Vāsudeva, the worthy refuge: victorious, sinless, invincible, omnipresent, the God of gods, / whose power is ever ready to destroy the enemies of the thirty [gods], / worshipful by the best of twice-born and gods, the destroyer of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
vasunā vasuveśena vāgminā viṣṇur īḍitaḥ
uvāca prāñjaliṃ prahvaṃ pārthivaṃ purataḥ sthitam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
वसुना वसुवेशेन वाग्मिना विष्णुर् ईडितः
उवाच प्राञ्जलिं प्रह्वं पार्थिवं पुरतः स्थितम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Praised by Vasu, clad in radiant form and eloquent, Viṣṇu / spoke to the king who stood before him, bowed with folded hands:

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudeva uvāca
nānṛtaṃ nṛpa vaktavyaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagair api
dharmapraśno na vaktavyas tathaikena viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
वासुदेव उवाच
नानृतं नृप वक्तव्यं प्राणैः कण्ठगैर् अपि
धर्मप्रश्नो न वक्तव्यस् तथैकेन विशेषतः //
text_mt: Vāsudeva said: / An untruth must not be spoken, O king, even when breath has reached the throat; / and especially a question of dharma must not be stated by one alone,

sanskrit_iast:
bahujñenāpi dharmajña dharmakāmena karhicit
durvijñeyās tathā dharmāḥ sūkṣmā rājan duranvayāḥ //
meaning:
बहुज्ञेनापि धर्मज्ञ धर्मकामेन कर्हिचित्
दुर्विज्ञेयास् तथा धर्माः सूक्ष्मा राजन् दुरन्वयाः //
text_mt: even by one who knows much, O knower of dharma, who desires dharma at any time. / For duties are difficult to discern, subtle, O king, and hard to trace.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmān naikena vaktavyāḥ kadācid api jānatā
uktvānṛtaṃ mahat prāptaṃ tvayā kṛcchraṃ narādhipa //
meaning:
तस्मान् नैकेन वक्तव्याः कदाचिद् अपि जानता
उक्त्वानृतं महत् प्राप्तं त्वया कृच्छ्रं नराधिप //
text_mt: Therefore, they must never be stated by one person alone, even if knowing. / By having spoken an untruth, great distress was incurred by you, O lord of men;

sanskrit_iast:
gatibhraṃśas tathaivāptā devajñārthavādinā
mama bhakto 'si satataṃ tena te niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā //
meaning:
गतिभ्रंशस् तथैवाप्ता देवज्ञार्थवादिना
मम भक्तो ऽसि सततं तेन ते निष्कृतिः कृता //
text_mt: and fall from your realm was likewise attained by you who spoke regarding the knowledge of the gods. / You are ever my devotee; on that account your expiation has been made.

sanskrit_iast:
kālenālpena kalpena yā na śakyā surāsuraiḥ
gaccha pālaya rājyaṃ tvaṃ tathaivāvicalo bhava //
meaning:
कालेनाल्पेन कल्पेन या न शक्या सुरासुरैः
गच्छ पालय राज्यं त्वं तथैवाविचलो भव //
text_mt: In a short time, which was not capable [of being attained] by gods and asuras even in an aeon. / Go, protect your kingdom, and remain likewise unwavering.

sanskrit_iast:
nāvamānaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kathaṃcana
brāhmaṇo hi mahad bhūtaṃ vijñeyaṃ daivataṃ param //
meaning:
नावमानं त्वया कार्यं ब्राह्मणानां कथंचन
ब्राह्मणो हि महद् भूतं विज्ञेयं दैवतं परम् //
text_mt: No disrespect whatsoever should be shown by you to brāhmaṇas; / for a brāhmaṇa is a great being, to be known as the supreme divinity.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evam uktvā vasuṃ viṣṇus tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ
tārkṣyeṇa sahito rājan vismitaś cābhavad vasuḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा वसुं विष्णुस् तत्रैवादर्शनं गतः
तार्क्ष्येण सहितो राजन् विस्मितश् चाभवद् वसुः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus to Vasu, Viṣṇu vanished right there / along with Garuḍa, O king; and Vasu was filled with wonder.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ cāvāpa bhūyo 'pi khecaratvaṃ tathaiva ca
tataḥ sabhājitaś cāpi devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāgataiḥ //
meaning:
राज्यं चावाप भूयो ऽपि खेचरत्वं तथैव च
ततः सभाजितश् चापि देवैः सर्वैः समागतैः //
text_mt: He also regained his kingdom once more, and likewise the ability to move through the sky; / then he was greeted with respect by all the gods assembled together.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa devena hi bhaktiyukto rasātalastho vasudhādhipeśaḥ
bhayāt sughorāt pravimucya yukto rājyena gatvā nabhasas tathaiva //
meaning:
एवं स देवेन हि भक्तियुक्तो रसातलस्थो वसुधाधिपेशः
भयात् सुघोरात् प्रविमुच्य युक्तो राज्येन गत्वा नभसस् तथैव //
text_mt: Thus that lord of the rulers of the earth, endowed with devotion to the god, / was freed from terrifying fear while dwelling in Rasātala, and endowed with his kingdom, after going to the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
vajra uvāca
viśvarūpaṃ samācakṣva devadevasya cakriṇaḥ
kasya tūddarśitaṃ tena bhṛguvaṃśavivardhana //
meaning:
वज्र उवाच
विश्वरूपं समाचक्ष्व देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः
कस्य तूद्दर्शितं तेन भृगुवंशविवर्धन //
text_mt: Vajra said: / Describe the universal form of the God of gods who bears the discus; / to whom was it shown by him, O enhancer of the Bhṛgu lineage?

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
ekāntabhāvanābhaktair dṛṣṭāni bahuśaḥ purā
viśvarūpāṇi devasya yāny aśakyāni bhāṣitum //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एकान्तभावनाभक्तैर् दृष्टानि बहुशः पुरा
विश्वरूपाणि देवस्य यान्य् अशक्यानि भाषितुम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / By devotees with exclusive devotion the universal forms of the God, / which are impossible to describe, were seen many times of old.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevaprasādena na bhaved divyadarśanaḥ
viśvarūpadharaṃ draṣṭuṃ tāvac chaktir na vidyate //
meaning:
वासुदेवप्रसादेन न भवेद् दिव्यदर्शनः
विश्वरूपधरं द्रष्टुं तावच् छक्तिर् न विद्यते //
text_mt: Without the grace of Vāsudeva, one does not become endowed with divine vision; / until then there is no capacity to see him bearing the universal form.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra yad darśitaṃ caiva nāradasya purānagha
tat te 'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi viśvadevena viṣṇunā //
meaning:
तत्र यद् दर्शितं चैव नारदस्य पुरानघ
तत् ते ऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि विश्वदेवेन विष्णुना //
text_mt: In that regard, that which was shown of old to Nārada, O sinless one, / by Viṣṇu, the God of all, that I shall declare to you.

sanskrit_iast:
nāradaḥ sumahadbhūtaṃ naranārāyaṇāśrayam
badaryāśramam ity uktaṃ jagāmātimanoharam //
meaning:
नारदः सुमहद्भूतं नरनारायणाश्रयम्
बदर्याश्रमम् इत्य् उक्तं जगामातिमनोहरम् //
text_mt: Nārada went to Badaryāśrama, very wonderful, / the abode of Nara-Nārāyaṇa, celebrated as exceedingly delightful,

sanskrit_iast:
caturātmā harir yatra dharmaputratvam āgataḥ
hariḥ kṛṣṇo naraś caiva tathā nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ //
meaning:
चतुरात्मा हरिर् यत्र धर्मपुत्रत्वम् आगतः
हरिः कृष्णो नरश् चैव तथा नारायणः प्रभुः //
text_mt: where Hari, fourfold in self, assumed the state of being the sons of Dharma: / Hari, Kṛṣṇa, Nara, and Lord Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sthit[au] vṛtte tadā lokāntare kila
naranārāyaṇau devau tapasy ugre tathā ratau //
meaning:
हरिः कृष्णः स्थित्[औ] वृत्ते तदा लोकान्तरे किल
नरनारायणौ देवौ तपस्य् उग्रे तथा रतौ //
text_mt: Hari and Kṛṣṇa had departed, staying in another world at that time, so it is said; / the two gods Nara and Nārāyaṇa were engaged in severe austerity.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭacakre sthitau yāne bhūtiyukte manohare
ekapādau nirālambau tathaivordhvabhujāv ubhau //
meaning:
अष्टचक्रे स्थितौ याने भूतियुक्ते मनोहरे
एकपादौ निरालम्बौ तथैवोर्ध्वभुजाव् उभौ //
text_mt: Stationed on an eight-wheeled vehicle, full of splendour and charming, / standing on one foot, without support, both with arms raised aloft.

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa nāradas tatra tāv ubhau dīptatejasau
abhivādya gatau devau tayos tu purataḥ sthitaḥ //
meaning:
ददर्श नारदस् तत्र ताव् उभौ दीप्ततेजसौ
अभिवाद्य गतौ देवौ तयोस् तु पुरतः स्थितः //
text_mt: Nārada saw both of them there, of blazing splendour; / having saluted the two departed gods, he stood before them.

sanskrit_iast:
pādyārghācamanīyādyaiḥ pūjitaḥ saṃs tadā dvijaḥ
naranārāyaṇābhyā[ṃs] tu tatrovāsa tadāśrame //
meaning:
पाद्यार्घाचमनीयाद्यैः पूजितः संस् तदा द्विजः
नरनारायणाभ्या[ंस्] तु तत्रोवास तदाश्रमे //
text_mt: Worshipped then by Nara and Nārāyaṇa with water for feet, respectful offering, sipping water, and other rites, / the twice-born dwelt there in that hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
āśramasthaḥ sa viprendraḥ kadācid devasattamau
dadarśa vighnaṃ kurvāṇau devakarma tathānaghau //
meaning:
आश्रमस्थः स विप्रेन्द्रः कदाचिद् देवसत्तमौ
ददर्श विघ्नं कुर्वाणौ देवकर्म तथानघौ //
text_mt: Dwelling in the hermitage, that best of vipras once saw the two best of gods, / the sinless ones, performing divine rites without obstacle.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kṛtāhnik[au] prāha nāradas tau jagadgurū
bhavantau jagatāṃ nāthau bhavantau parameśvarau //
meaning:
ततः कृताह्निक्[औ] प्राह नारदस् तौ जगद्गुरू
भवन्तौ जगतां नाथौ भवन्तौ परमेश्वरौ //
text_mt: Then, when their daily rites were completed, Nārada spoke to the two teachers of the world: / "You two are the lords of the worlds, you two are the supreme rulers.

sanskrit_iast:
ārādhanārthaṃ kasyeha tapasy abhiratāv ubhau
bhavadbhyām arcyate kaś ca daive pitrye ca kalpyate //
meaning:
आराधनार्थं कस्येह तपस्य् अभिरताव् उभौ
भवद्भ्याम् अर्च्यते कश् च दैवे पित्र्ये च कल्प्यते //
text_mt: For whose propitiation are you both here engaged in austerity? / Who is worshipped by you two and intended in rites to gods and ancestors?"

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtir yā parāsmākaṃ yataḥ sarvasya saṃbhavaḥ
maryādādarśanārthāya navaṃ tam aparājitam //
meaning:
प्रकृतिर् या परास्माकं यतः सर्वस्य संभवः
मर्यादादर्शनार्थाय नवं तम् अपराजितम् //
text_mt: ["The two said:] / Our supreme Prakṛti, from whom is the origin of all, / in order to show the proper norm, we ever worship that new, undefeated [Lord],

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayāmaḥ sadā brahman daive pitrye ca kalpite
viprān devagurūn gāś ca pitṝṃś caiva jagattraye //
meaning:
पूजयामः सदा ब्रह्मन् दैवे पित्र्ये च कल्पिते
विप्रान् देवगुरून् गाश् च पितॄंश् चैव जगत्त्रये //
text_mt: O brahman, in rites intended for gods and ancestors. / In the three worlds, vipras, divine gurus, cows, and the ancestors—

sanskrit_iast:
ye 'rcayanty arcayanty eva taṃ devaṃ parameśvaram
yo 'yam apy arcayed devaṃ tena syāt pūjito hariḥ //
meaning:
ये ऽर्चयन्त्य् अर्चयन्त्य् एव तं देवं परमेश्वरम्
यो ऽयम् अप्य् अर्चयेद् देवं तेन स्यात् पूजितो हरिः //
text_mt: those who worship them, worship indeed that God, the supreme Lord; / whoever worships a god, by him Hari is worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhihīnaṃ mahābhāga sa hi sarvagato yataḥ
devasyānyasya yac cārcāṃ kartukāmo 'rcayed dharim //
meaning:
विधिहीनं महाभाग स हि सर्वगतो यतः
देवस्यान्यस्य यच् चार्चां कर्तुकामो ऽर्चयेद् धरिम् //
text_mt: Even if devoid of rule, O fortunate one, since he is omnipresent. / And if one wishing to make worship of another god worships Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
tena tasya kṛtārcā syād dvijaśreṣṭha vidhānataḥ
deve yasmāt surāḥ sarvaṃ trailokyam api yad gatam //
meaning:
तेन तस्य कृतार्चा स्याद् द्विजश्रेष्ठ विधानतः
देवे यस्मात् सुराः सर्वं त्रैलोक्यम् अपि यद् गतम् //
text_mt: by that, worship of him is performed according to the prescribed rite, O best of the twice-born; / for the gods and all that is contained in the three worlds reside in the God.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtā trailokyapūjā syād viṣṇupūjāvidhāyinā
nāsti lokeṣu tad brahma yatra nāsti janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
कृता त्रैलोक्यपूजा स्याद् विष्णुपूजाविधायिना
नास्ति लोकेषु तद् ब्रह्म यत्र नास्ति जनार्दनः //
text_mt: Worship of the three worlds is performed by one who performs the worship of Viṣṇu. / There is no such Brahman in the worlds where Janārdana is not present;

sanskrit_iast:
na tad apy asti lokeṣu yan na viṣṇau pratiṣṭhitam
yasmin sarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaḥ sarvaṃ sarvataś ca yaḥ //
meaning:
न तद् अप्य् अस्ति लोकेषु यन् न विष्णौ प्रतिष्ठितम्
यस्मिन् सर्वं यतः सर्वं यः सर्वं सर्वतश् च यः //
text_mt: nor is there anything in the worlds that is not established in Viṣṇu: / in whom is all, from whom is all, who is all, and who is everywhere,

sanskrit_iast:
yaś ca sarvamayo nityaṃ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ
kṣīrodamadhye dvīpo 'sti bahuyojanavistṛtaḥ //
meaning:
यश् च सर्वमयो नित्यं तस्मै सर्वात्मने नमः
क्षीरोदमध्ये द्वीपो ऽस्ति बहुयोजनविस्तृतः //
text_mt: and who is eternally composed of all—homage to him, the Self of all! / In the middle of the Kṣīroda ocean there is an island extending many yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra te puruṣāḥ śvetāḥ śaśāṅkasamatejasaḥ
upetāś ca tathā sarve cakrava[r]tyupalakṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्र ते पुरुषाः श्वेताः शशाङ्कसमतेजसः
उपेताश् च तथा सर्वे चक्रव[र्]त्युपलक्षणैः //
text_mt: There the men are white, of splendour equal to the moon, / and all are endowed with the marks of universal emperors.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcarātravidhānajñāḥ pūjayanti sadā harim
māyādeham athāsthāya devo 'pi madhusūdanaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चरात्रविधानज्ञाः पूजयन्ति सदा हरिम्
मायादेहम् अथास्थाय देवो ऽपि मधुसूदनः //
text_mt: Knowing the prescribed rite of the Pañcarātra, they ever worship Hari. / Moreover, assuming an illusory body, the god Madhusūdana too—"

sanskrit_iast:
tatpūjāṃ pratigṛhṇāti śirasā satataṃ hariḥ
taiḥ sārdhaṃ ramate nityaṃ taiś ca saṃpūjyate sadā //
meaning:
तत्पूजां प्रतिगृह्णाति शिरसा सततं हरिः
तैः सार्धं रमते नित्यं तैश् च संपूज्यते सदा //
text_mt: Hari continually accepts their worship upon his head; / he ever delights with them, and by them he is always worshipped.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāntabhāvopagatā ye bhavantīha mānavāḥ
akāmāś ca jagannātham arcayanti sadā ca ye //
meaning:
एकान्तभावोपगता ये भवन्तीह मानवाः
अकामाश् च जगन्नाथम् अर्चयन्ति सदा च ये //
text_mt: Those men here who are endowed with exclusive devotion, / and who, devoid of desire, ever worship the lord of the world,

sanskrit_iast:
te yānti deham utsṛjya tad dvīpaṃ śvetasaṃjñitam
aniṣyandā nirāhārāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ //
meaning:
ते यान्ति देहम् उत्सृज्य तद् द्वीपं श्वेतसंज्ञितम्
अनिष्यन्दा निराहाराः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः //
text_mt: having abandoned the body, they go to that island called Śveta, / free from exudation, taking no food, all-knowing, and seeing everything.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvarā nityatṛptāḥ paraṃ sukham upāgatāḥ
pūjayanti hariṃ tatra divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वरा नित्यतृप्ताः परं सुखम् उपागताः
पूजयन्ति हरिं तत्र दिव्यं वर्षशतं पुनः //
text_mt: Lords of all, eternally contented, having attained supreme bliss, / they worship Hari there again for a hundred divine years.

sanskrit_iast:
tato 'rkamaṇḍalaṃ bhittvā aniruddhaṃ vaśanti te
brahmaṃs tapobhiḥ pradyumnaṃ tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ prabhum //
meaning:
ततो ऽर्कमण्डलं भित्त्वा अनिरुद्धं वशन्ति ते
ब्रह्मंस् तपोभिः प्रद्युम्नं ततः संकर्षणं प्रभुम् //
text_mt: Then, having pierced the solar disc, they dwell in Aniruddha, / [and then], O brahmin, through austerities, in Pradyumna, and then in the lord Saṃkarṣaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevaṃ tataḥ prāpya tenaiva sadṛśās tataḥ
bhavanti sarve sarvatra sarvadā sarvaśaktayaḥ //
meaning:
वासुदेवं ततः प्राप्य तेनैव सदृशास् ततः
भवन्ति सर्वे सर्वत्र सर्वदा सर्वशक्तयः //
text_mt: Then, having reached Vāsudeva, they become just like him; / thereupon all become omnipotent, everywhere, at all times,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāś ca sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ paraṃ sukham upāgatāḥ
sa tvaṃ śīghram ito gatvā śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
मुक्ताश् च सर्वदुःखेभ्यः परं सुखम् उपागताः
स त्वं शीघ्रम् इतो गत्वा श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनः //
text_mt: and, freed from all sufferings, they have attained supreme bliss. / So go quickly from here and [look upon] the dwellers of Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
paśya tvaṃ puruṣān brahman prasannaḥ sa vibhus tava
darśayiṣyati rūpaṃ tu trailokyādbhutam adbhutam //
meaning:
पश्य त्वं पुरुषान् ब्रह्मन् प्रसन्नः स विभुस् तव
दर्शयिष्यति रूपं तु त्रैलोक्याद्भुतम् अद्भुतम् //
text_mt: Behold those men, O brahmin; that lord, being pleased with you, / will show [you] his wondrous form, a marvel to the three worlds,

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaṃ brāhmaṇaśārdūla prītaṃ madhuniṣūdanam
ekataś ca dvitaś caiva tritaś caiva mahātapāḥ //
meaning:
विश्वं ब्राह्मणशार्दूल प्रीतं मधुनिषूदनम्
एकतश् च द्वितश् चैव त्रितश् चैव महातपाः //
text_mt: [his] universal form, O tiger among brahmins, pleased Madhusūdana. / Ekata, Dvita, and Trita of great austerities,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ tu deśaṃ gatā brahman na tair dṛṣṭo janārdanaḥ
ekāntabhāvopagatās tena yasmāj jagadguroḥ //
meaning:
तं तु देशं गता ब्रह्मन् न तैर् दृष्टो जनार्दनः
एकान्तभावोपगतास् तेन यस्माज् जगद्गुरोः //
text_mt: having gone to that realm, O brahmin, did not see Janārdana, / because [only] those endowed with exclusive devotion [can see] the world-teacher.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaṃ taiḥ śritaḥ ślokaḥ śvetadvīpanivāsibhiḥ
udīrito mahābhāgaiḥ sarvakalmaṣavarjitaiḥ //
meaning:
केवलं तैः श्रितः श्लोकः श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिभिः
उदीरितो महाभागैः सर्वकल्मषवर्जितैः //
text_mt: They only heard the verse uttered by the dwellers of Śvetadvīpa, / the highly fortunate ones free of all taint:

sanskrit_iast:
jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namas te viśvabhāvana
namas te 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja //
meaning:
जितं ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस् ते विश्वभावन
नमस् ते ऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुष पूर्वज //
text_mt: “Victory to you, O Puṇḍarīkākṣa! Homage to you, creator of the universe! / May homage be to you, O Hṛṣīkeśa, supreme person, first-born!”

sanskrit_iast:
ślokam etaṃ tu te śrutvā śrutavantas tathā giram
aśarīrāṃ mahābhāga sarvabhūtāvahāṃ hareḥ //
meaning:
श्लोकम् एतं तु ते श्रुत्वा श्रुतवन्तस् तथा गिरम्
अशरीरां महाभाग सर्वभूतावहां हरेः //
text_mt: Hearing this verse, they also heard a bodiless voice / of Hari, O highly fortunate one, bringing benefit to all beings:

sanskrit_iast:
śvetadvīpam athāsādya mṛtyum āpnoti karhicit
śvetadvīpe gatir nāsti vinā caikāntibhir dvijāḥ //
meaning:
श्वेतद्वीपम् अथासाद्य मृत्युम् आप्नोति कर्हिचित्
श्वेतद्वीपे गतिर् नास्ति विना चैकान्तिभिर् द्विजाः //
text_mt: “[Does anyone] meet death ever after reaching Śvetadvīpa? / There is no entry into Śvetadvīpa without being single-minded devotees, O brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyabhāvanā bhaktā bhavantaś ca tapodhanāḥ
tapasogreṇa saṃyuktās tena me deśam āgatāḥ //
meaning:
सामान्यभावना भक्ता भवन्तश् च तपोधनाः
तपसोग्रेण संयुक्तास् तेन मे देशम् आगताः //
text_mt: You are devotees with ordinary devotion, rich in asceticism; / endowed with fierce tapas, therefore have you come to my realm.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyabhaktisattvāś ca punar vrajata mā ciram
bhavadbhiḥ puruṣā dṛṣṭāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ //
meaning:
सामान्यभक्तिसत्त्वाश् च पुनर् व्रजत मा चिरम्
भवद्भिः पुरुषा दृष्टाः श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनः //
text_mt: You of ordinary devotion and resolve, return without delay; / you have seen the men who dwell in Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiḥ ślokais tathā dṛṣṭo bhavatīti janārdanaḥ
ekāntabhāvanāsaktaiḥ ślokais tu puruṣair imam //
meaning:
एभिः श्लोकैस् तथा दृष्टो भवतीति जनार्दनः
एकान्तभावनासक्तैः श्लोकैस् तु पुरुषैर् इमम् //
text_mt: Through these verses Janārdana is likewise seen; / by men devoted to exclusive devotion, this [verse]

sanskrit_iast:
japtavyaṃ satataṃ viprās tataḥ punar ih[ai]ṣyatha
śloko 'yaṃ pāvanaḥ puṇyaḥ sarvāghaviniṣūdanaḥ //
meaning:
जप्तव्यं सततं विप्रास् ततः पुनर् इह्[ऐ]ष्यथ
श्लोको ऽयं पावनः पुण्यः सर्वाघविनिषूदनः //
text_mt: must be constantly muttered, O brahmins; then you will come here again. / This verse is purifying, meritorious, destroying all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
ślokair bhāvena kartavyau japahomau vijānatā
dhūpadīpānnapuṣpāṇāṃ tathaiva ca nivedanam //
meaning:
श्लोकैर् भावेन कर्तव्यौ जपहोमौ विजानता
धूपदीपान्नपुष्पाणां तथैव च निवेदनम् //
text_mt: The knowing man must perform japa and homa with these verses and with devotion, / as well as the offering of incense, lamps, food, and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
ślokam etaṃ paṭhed viprā namaskāre pradakṣiṇe
snānam etena kartavyaṃ tathā cānte jalaṃ dvijāḥ //
meaning:
श्लोकम् एतं पठेद् विप्रा नमस्कारे प्रदक्षिणे
स्नानम् एतेन कर्तव्यं तथा चान्ते जलं द्विजाः //
text_mt: A wise man should recite this verse during prostration and clockwise circumambulation; / bathing should be performed with this, and at the end water [offered], O brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ mokṣadaṃ sarvakāmadam
śloka eṣa vinirdiṣṭaḥ sarvakāmapradaḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं मोक्षदं सर्वकामदम्
श्लोक एष विनिर्दिष्टः सर्वकामप्रदः शिवः //
text_mt: Removing all sins, meritorious, granting liberation, granting all desires, / this auspicious verse is declared to bestow all wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
āpatprāptena japtavyaṃ tan mokṣārthaṃ tathaiva ca
etasya jāpaḥ kartavyo nityam eva vijānatā //
meaning:
आपत्प्राप्तेन जप्तव्यं तन् मोक्षार्थं तथैव च
एतस्य जापः कर्तव्यो नित्यम् एव विजानता //
text_mt: It should be muttered by one fallen into misfortune, and likewise for the sake of liberation; / japa of this must be performed constantly by the knowing person.

sanskrit_iast:
etasya jāpāt puruṣaḥ sarvān kāmān upāśnute
etāṃ śrutvā tu te vāṇīṃ cāgatā magadhāḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
एतस्य जापात् पुरुषः सर्वान् कामान् उपाश्नुते
एतां श्रुत्वा तु ते वाणीं चागता मगधाः पुनः //
text_mt: From the japa of this, a person attains all desires.” / Having heard this voice, those [sages] returned to the Magadhas.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭavanto vasuṃ tatra yajamānaṃ mahīpatiṃ
yājako yasya dharmātmā devācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
दृष्टवन्तो वसुं तत्र यजमानं महीपतिं
याजको यस्य धर्मात्मा देवाचार्यो बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: There they saw King Vasu acting as the patron of the sacrifice, / whose officiating priest was the righteous Bṛhaspati, the teacher of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyena hṛto bhāgas tatra devena viṣṇunā
jagṛhur devatāḥ sarvā dṛśyabhāgāt purodhasaḥ //
meaning:
अदृश्येन हृतो भागस् तत्र देवेन विष्णुना
जगृहुर् देवताः सर्वा दृश्यभागात् पुरोधसः //
text_mt: There, the share was taken invisibly by the god Viṣṇu; / all the [other] deities took their visible shares from the priest.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuṃ prati gatakrodhaṃ devācāryaṃ bṛhaspatim
ekataś ca dvitaś caiva tritaś caivam avocatam //
meaning:
विष्णुं प्रति गतक्रोधं देवाचार्यं बृहस्पतिम्
एकतश् च द्वितश् चैव त्रितश् चैवम् अवोचतम् //
text_mt: To Bṛhaspati, the teacher of the gods, who was enraged at Viṣṇu, / Ekata, Dvita, and Trita spoke thus:

sanskrit_iast:
adṛśyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ taṃ kathaṃ draṣṭum icchasi
ity evam anunītas tu devācryo bṛhaspatiḥ //
meaning:
अदृश्यः सर्वदेवानां तं कथं द्रष्टुम् इच्छसि
इत्य् एवम् अनुनीतस् तु देवाच्र्यो बृहस्पतिः //
text_mt: “He is invisible to all the gods; how do you wish to see him?” / Thus pacified, Bṛhaspati, the teacher of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpayām āsa tadā taṃ yajñaṃ pārthivasya ca
ekāntabhāvopagatā ṛṣayo 'pi janārdanam //
meaning:
समापयाम् आस तदा तं यज्ञं पार्थिवस्य च
एकान्तभावोपगता ऋषयो ऽपि जनार्दनम् //
text_mt: then brought that sacrifice of the king to completion. / Even the ṛṣis endowed with exclusive devotion to Janārdana,

sanskrit_iast:
āgatā devakāryārthaṃ śvetadvīpāt purā dvija
śvetadvīpaṃ punaḥ prāptaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham //
meaning:
आगता देवकार्यार्थं श्वेतद्वीपात् पुरा द्विज
श्वेतद्वीपं पुनः प्राप्तं पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् //
text_mt: having come from Śvetadvīpa for divine business in ancient times, O brahmin, / reached Śvetadvīpa again, which is hard to attain for one who must return.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāt taṃ devadeveśaṃ tatrasthaṃ paśya nārada
tvayāpi devakāryāṇi kartavyāni bahūny atha //
meaning:
तस्मात् तं देवदेवेशं तत्रस्थं पश्य नारद
त्वयापि देवकार्याणि कर्तव्यानि बहून्य् अथ //
text_mt: Therefore, see that lord of the gods who resides there, O Nārada; / for you too have many divine tasks to perform.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetadvīpagatasyāpi tena te dvija sāmpratam
na bhaviṣyati lokeṣu gatir nirvāṇakāriṇī
kalpāvasāne tu gatiṃ tāṃ tvaṃ vipra gamiṣyasi //
meaning:
श्वेतद्वीपगतस्यापि तेन ते द्विज साम्प्रतम्
न भविष्यति लोकेषु गतिर् निर्वाणकारिणी
कल्पावसाने तु गतिं तां त्वं विप्र गमिष्यसि //
text_mt: Even though you go to Śvetadvīpa, O brahmin, you will not at present / have in the worlds that state which brings nirvāṇa; / but at the end of the kalpa, O brahmin, you will attain that state.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
evam uktas tataḥ śīghraṃ manomārutaraṃhasā
abhivādyātha tau devau taṃ dvīpaṃ nārado gataḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एवम् उक्तस् ततः शीघ्रं मनोमारुतरंहसा
अभिवाद्याथ तौ देवौ तं द्वीपं नारदो गतः //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Addressed thus, having saluted those two gods, Nārada then went quickly / to that island with the speed of mind and wind.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra gatvā dadṛśe śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ
pūjayām āsa śirasā tāṃś ca bhaktyā sa nāradaḥ //
meaning:
स तत्र गत्वा ददृशे श्वेतद्वीपनिवासिनः
पूजयाम् आस शिरसा तांश् च भक्त्या स नारदः //
text_mt: Having gone there, he saw the dwellers of Śvetadvīpa, / and Nārada worshipped them with his head, full of devotion.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ
dadarśa tān eva narāñ śvetā[ṃś] candraprabhāñ śubhān //
meaning:
प्राप्य श्वेतं महाद्वीपं नारदो हृष्टमानसः
ददर्श तान् एव नराञ् श्वेता[ंश्] चन्द्रप्रभाञ् शुभान् //
text_mt: Having reached the great White Island, Nārada, glad at heart, / saw those very men, white, lustrous as the moon, auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayām āsa śirasā manasā tais tu pūjitaḥ
didṛkṣur jāpyaparamaḥ sarvakṛcchradharaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयाम् आस शिरसा मनसा तैस् तु पूजितः
दिदृक्षुर् जाप्यपरमः सर्वकृच्छ्रधरः स्मृतः //
text_mt: He honoured them with his head, and was mentally honoured by them; / desirous to see [the Lord], devoted to japa, regarded as enduring every hardship,

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtvaikāmanā vipraś cordhvabāhur mahābhujaḥ
stotraṃ jagau sa viśvāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane //
meaning:
भूत्वैकामना विप्रश् चोर्ध्वबाहुर् महाभुजः
स्तोत्रं जगौ स विश्वाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने //
text_mt: having become single-minded, the large-armed brahmin, with arms raised high, / sang a hymn of praise to the Universal One, devoid of qualities yet the self of qualities,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevāya śāntāya tathā viśvasṛje dvija
anantāyāprameyāya sarvagāyātiraṃhase //
meaning:
वासुदेवाय शान्ताय तथा विश्वसृजे द्विज
अनन्तायाप्रमेयाय सर्वगायातिरंहसे //
text_mt: to peaceful Vāsudeva, and the creator of the universe, O brahmin, / to the endless, the immeasurable, the omnipresent, exceedingly swift,

sanskrit_iast:
amitabalaparākramāya tasmai tridaśamunipratipūjitāya nityam
bhavabhavabharanāśanāya viṣṇoḥ praṇatajanapratipāpanāśanāya //
meaning:
अमितबलपराक्रमाय तस्मै त्रिदशमुनिप्रतिपूजिताय नित्यम्
भवभवभरनाशनाय विष्णोः प्रणतजनप्रतिपापनाशनाय //
text_mt: to him of boundless strength and valour, perpetually worshipped by gods and munis, / to Viṣṇu, destroyer of the burden of worldly existence, destroyer of the sins of those who bow to him.
