sanskrit_iast: bhakto 'haṃ tvāṃ didṛkṣur ekāntadarśanāyety oṃ namaḥ /
meaning: भक्तो ऽहं त्वां दिदृक्षुर् एकान्तदर्शनायेत्य् ओं नमः /
text_mt: I, your devotee, wishing to see you, [bow down] for an exclusive vision: Oṃ, reverence [to you]!

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
sa dadarśa tadā viṣṇuṃ viśvarūpadharaṃ harim
yuktaṃ varṇaiḥ śukraprakhyaiḥ pītaraktasitāsitaiḥ //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
स ददर्श तदा विष्णुं विश्वरूपधरं हरिम्
युक्तं वर्णैः शुक्रप्रख्यैः पीतरक्तसितासितैः //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then he beheld Viṣṇu, Hari bearing the universal form, / endowed with colors resembling semen, yellow, red, white, and black;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacin mecakasaṃyuktaiḥ kvacin mecakarañjitaiḥ
[kva]cic chaśāṅkasaṃkāśaṃ kvacid dhiṅgulasaṃnibham //
meaning:
क्वचिन् मेचकसंयुक्तैः क्वचिन् मेचकरञ्जितैः
[क्व]चिच् छशाङ्कसंकाशं क्वचिद् धिङ्गुलसंनिभम् //
text_mt: in some places mixed with dark blue, in some places colored with dark blue; / in some places resembling the moon, in some places like cinnabar;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacin marakataprakhyaṃ padmarāganibhaṃ kvacit
kvacit kanakasaṃkāśaṃ kvacin nīlotpalaprabham //
meaning:
क्वचिन् मरकतप्रख्यं पद्मरागनिभं क्वचित्
क्वचित् कनकसंकाशं क्वचिन् नीलोत्पलप्रभम् //
text_mt: in some places resembling emerald, in some places like ruby; / in some places resembling gold, in some places with the splendor of a blue lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacit pāṭalapuṣpābham kvacid gaganasaṃnibham
kuṃkumakṣodasaṃkāśaṃ haridrakṣodasaṃnibham //
meaning:
क्वचित् पाटलपुष्पाभम् क्वचिद् गगनसंनिभम्
कुंकुमक्षोदसंकाशं हरिद्रक्षोदसंनिभम् //
text_mt: in some places with the luster of a trumpet-flower, in some places resembling the sky; / resembling saffron powder, resembling turmeric powder;

sanskrit_iast:
kvacid rajopalaprakhyam indranīlanibhaṃ kvacit
anirdeśyāni varṇāni tathā bibhrat kvacit kvacit //
meaning:
क्वचिद् रजोपलप्रख्यम् इन्द्रनीलनिभं क्वचित्
अनिर्देश्यानि वर्णानि तथा बिभ्रत् क्वचित् क्वचित् //
text_mt: in some places resembling a silver-stone, in some places like a sapphire; / and likewise displaying indescribable colors in various places;

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvidhānāṃ sattvānāṃ vadanāni bahūni ca
brahmaśaṃkaraśakrāṇāṃ yamasya varuṇasya ca //
meaning:
नानाविधानां सत्त्वानां वदनानि बहूनि च
ब्रह्मशंकरशक्राणां यमस्य वरुणस्य च //
text_mt: and [he saw] many faces of various kinds of beings: / of Brahmā, Śaṃkara, and Indra, and of Yama and Varuṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
dhanadasya hutāśanasya vāyor nirṛtinas tathā
grahāṇām atha ṛkṣāṇāṃ rudrāṇāṃ vasubhiḥ saha //
meaning:
धनदस्य हुताशनस्य वायोर् निरृतिनस् तथा
ग्रहाणाम् अथ ऋक्षाणां रुद्राणां वसुभिः सह //
text_mt: of Kubera, the fire-god, the wind-god, and also of Nirṛti; / of the planets and the lunar mansions, of the Rudras together with the Vasus;

sanskrit_iast:
ādityānāṃ samarutāṃ bhṛgūṇāṃ ca tathā dvija
tathaivāṅgiraso rājan sādhyānām aśvibhiḥ saha //
meaning:
आदित्यानां समरुतां भृगूणां च तथा द्विज
तथैवाङ्गिरसो राजन् साध्यानाम् अश्विभिः सह //
text_mt: of the Ādityas with the Maruts, and likewise of the Bhṛgus, O twice-born one; / just so of the Aṅgirases, O king, and of the Sādhyas together with the Aśvins;

sanskrit_iast:
daityānām atha nāgānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām
pitṛpannagayakṣāṇāṃ tathā ca piśitāśinām //
meaning:
दैत्यानाम् अथ नागानां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्
पितृपन्नगयक्षाणां तथा च पिशिताशिनाम् //
text_mt: of the Daityas and the Nāgas, of the Gandharvas, serpents, and Rākṣasas; / of the ancestors, serpents, and Yakṣas, as well as of the flesh-eaters;

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyahayanāgānāṃ gajāśvamṛgapakṣiṇāṃ
dvīpiśārdūlasiṃhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇinām atha //
meaning:
मनुष्यहयनागानां गजाश्वमृगपक्षिणां
द्वीपिशार्दूलसिंहानां सर्वेषां प्राणिनाम् अथ //
text_mt: of humans, horses, and serpents; of elephants, horses, beasts, and birds; / of leopards, tigers, and lions, and of all living creatures.

sanskrit_iast:
kānicit tasya saumyāni kānicid bhīṣaṇāni ca
dadarśa tasya vaktrāṇi śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
कानिचित् तस्य सौम्यानि कानिचिद् भीषणानि च
ददर्श तस्य वक्त्राणि शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Some of his faces were gentle, and some were terrifying; / he beheld his mouths by the hundreds and by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
vaktreṣu tasya raudrasya prāṇisaṃghāny anekaśaḥ
dadarśa sarvataś cāgnīn grasyamānāṃś ca viṣṇunā //
meaning:
वक्त्रेषु तस्य रौद्रस्य प्राणिसंघान्य् अनेकशः
ददर्श सर्वतश् चाग्नीन् ग्रस्यमानांश् च विष्णुना //
text_mt: In the mouths of that terrible one, [Nārada] saw numerous hosts of living beings / on all sides, and fires, being swallowed up by Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyebhyas tasya vaktrebhyo nirgacchantyas tathā prajāḥ
vāhāṃś ca vividhāṃs tasya sa dadarśātha nāradaḥ //
meaning:
सौम्येभ्यस् तस्य वक्त्रेभ्यो निर्गच्छन्त्यस् तथा प्रजाः
वाहांश् च विविधांस् तस्य स ददर्शाथ नारदः //
text_mt: And Nārada then beheld creatures emerging from his gentle mouths, / as well as his various mounts;

sanskrit_iast:
hastāṃś ca vividhākārān nānāmudrāsamanvitān
yuktān nānāvidhair bhāṇḍair āyudhaiś ca sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
हस्तांश् च विविधाकारान् नानामुद्रासमन्वितान्
युक्तान् नानाविधैर् भाण्डैर् आयुधैश् च सहस्रशः //
text_mt: and hands of various shapes, accompanied by diverse gestures, / equipped with utensils of many kinds and weapons by the thousands:

sanskrit_iast:
sruksruvāvedicamasakuśakṛṣṇājināgnibhiḥ
kecic ca kalaśaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ śaṅkhapadmotpalādibhiḥ //
meaning:
स्रुक्स्रुवावेदिचमसकुशकृष्णाजिनाग्निभिः
केचिच् च कलशं घण्टां शङ्खपद्मोत्पलादिभिः //
text_mt: with oblation-ladles, offering-spoons, altars, sacrificial cups, kuśa grass, black antelope skins, and fires; / and some with water-pots, bells, conches, lotuses, blue water-lilies, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
kecit khaḍgagadācakracarmaśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ
kecit pāśamahādaṇḍakṛpāṇaśarakārmukaiḥ //
meaning:
केचित् खड्गगदाचक्रचर्मशूलपरश्वधैः
केचित् पाशमहादण्डकृपाणशरकार्मुकैः //
text_mt: some with swords, clubs, discuses, shields, tridents, and battle-axes; / some with nooses, great rods, daggers, arrows, and bows;

sanskrit_iast:
kecid bhuśuṇḍīlaguḍaśaktivajrāśmapaṭṭiśaiḥ
bījapūrṇākṣamālāś ca pūrṇapātrais tathā paraiḥ //
meaning:
केचिद् भुशुण्डीलगुडशक्तिवज्राश्मपट्टिशैः
बीजपूर्णाक्षमालाश् च पूर्णपात्रैस् तथा परैः //
text_mt: some with bhuśuṇḍī-missiles, cudgels, spears, thunderbolts, sling-stones, and barbed darts; / and others with citrons, rosaries, and full vessels.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ nānāvidhair bhāṇḍaiḥ karāṃs tasya samanvitān
asaṃkhyeyān mahātejā dadarśa munisattamaḥ //
meaning:
एवं नानाविधैर् भाण्डैः करांस् तस्य समन्वितान्
असंख्येयान् महातेजा ददर्श मुनिसत्तमः //
text_mt: Thus the most excellent sage of great splendor beheld / his innumerable hands furnished with various kinds of implements.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛttaśāstravinirdiṣṭo nṛttakarmaṇi cāpy atha
śirāṃsi dṛṣṭayo hastāṃs tasya devasya dṛṣṭavān //
meaning:
नृत्तशास्त्रविनिर्दिष्टो नृत्तकर्मणि चाप्य् अथ
शिरांसि दृष्टयो हस्तांस् तस्य देवस्य दृष्टवान् //
text_mt: And then he saw the heads, glances, and hands of that god, / as prescribed in the treatise on dance and employed in the performance of dance.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyaṃ ca T kāye sakalaṃ munisattamaḥ
devadānavagandharvasayakṣoragarakṣasām //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यं च त् काये सकलं मुनिसत्तमः
देवदानवगन्धर्वसयक्षोरगरक्षसाम् //
text_mt: And the most excellent sage [saw] the entire three worlds in that body: / consisting of gods, Dānavas, and Gandharvas, together with Yakṣas, serpents, and Rākṣasas;

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpāmbhonidhilokaiś ca pātālaiś caiva saṃyutam
jagat samagraṃ devasya dehasthaṃ dṛṣṭavān muniḥ //
meaning:
द्वीपाम्भोनिधिलोकैश् च पातालैश् चैव संयुतम्
जगत् समग्रं देवस्य देहस्थं दृष्टवान् मुनिः //
text_mt: the sage beheld the whole universe residing in the body of the god, / together with the continents, the oceans, the worlds, and the nether regions.

sanskrit_iast:
sa dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ rūpaṃ bhīto hṛṣṭaś ca vismitaḥ
papāta pādayos tasya śirasā sāśrulocanaḥ //
meaning:
स दृष्ट्वा परमं रूपं भीतो हृष्टश् च विस्मितः
पपात पादयोस् तस्य शिरसा साश्रुलोचनः //
text_mt: Having seen that supreme form, frightened, rejoiced, and filled with wonder, / he fell at his feet with his head bowed, his eyes filled with tears.

sanskrit_iast:
stotreṇa caiva tuṣṭāva pūrvoktena janārdanam
tam uvāca tato devaḥ prahasann ṛṣisattamam //
meaning:
स्तोत्रेण चैव तुष्टाव पूर्वोक्तेन जनार्दनम्
तम् उवाच ततो देवः प्रहसन्न् ऋषिसत्तमम् //
text_mt: And he praised Janārdana with the previously spoken hymn of praise; / then the god, gently smiling, said to that best of ṛṣis:

sanskrit_iast:
uttiṣṭha mā bhair dharmajña varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam
nityam ekāntike deva bhaktir bhavatu sā tvayi
nānyaṃ varaṃ kāmayāmi narāṇām idam uttamam //
meaning:
उत्तिष्ठ मा भैर् धर्मज्ञ वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम्
नित्यम् एकान्तिके देव भक्तिर् भवतु सा त्वयि
नान्यं वरं कामयामि नराणाम् इदम् उत्तमम् //

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
tam uvāca tato devaḥ praṇatārtiharo hariḥ
etan nisargasiddhaṃ te yena tvaṃ dṛṣṭavān mama //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
तम् उवाच ततो देवः प्रणतार्तिहरो हरिः
एतन् निसर्गसिद्धं ते येन त्वं दृष्टवान् मम //
text_mt:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then the god, Hari, remover of the distress of those who bow to him, spoke to him:
“This has been achieved by your nature, whereby you have seen my

sanskrit_iast:
viśvarūpam idaṃ brahmann avajñeyaṃ tathā tvayā
tapas taptaṃ yato vipra mamāpi ca tatas tava //
meaning:
विश्वरूपम् इदं ब्रह्मन्न् अवज्ञेयं तथा त्वया
तपस् तप्तं यतो विप्र ममापि च ततस् तव //
text_mt:
universal form, O Brahmin, which is so difficult to know.
Because austerity was performed [by you], O Brahmin, and therefore [it was shown] by me to you.”

sanskrit_iast:
rūpam etat samāsthāya rūpaṃ svaṃ dvija darśitam
icchārūpāṇy ahaṃ kuryāṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
रूपम् एतत् समास्थाय रूपं स्वं द्विज दर्शितम्
इच्छारूपाण्य् अहं कुर्यां शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः //
text_mt: Resorting to this form, O twice-born, my own form has been shown [to you]. / I can assume willed forms by the hundreds and by the thousands.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokye yāni rūpāṇi devādīnāṃ dvijottama
mamaiva tāni jānīha matto 'nyan nāsti kiṃcana //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्ये यानि रूपाणि देवादीनां द्विजोत्तम
ममैव तानि जानीह मत्तो ऽन्यन् नास्ति किंचन //
text_mt: Whatever forms exist in the three worlds belonging to gods and others, O best of the twice-born, / know them to be mine alone; there is nothing whatsoever other than me.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca vartamānam ahaṃ tathā
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvam evāsmi nārada //
meaning:
अहं भूतं च भव्यं च वर्तमानम् अहं तथा
स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैव सर्वम् एवास्मि नारद //
text_mt: I am the past, the future, and likewise the present; / I am indeed all that is immobile and mobile, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
sac cāsac cāham evātra tattvam etad bravīmi te
aśabdam arasaṃ sparśagandharūpavivarjitam //
meaning:
सच् चासच् चाहम् एवात्र तत्त्वम् एतद् ब्रवीमि ते
अशब्दम् अरसं स्पर्शगन्धरूपविवर्जितम् //
text_mt: I alone am the existent and the non-existent here; I tell you this truth: / Soundless, tasteless, devoid of touch, smell, and form,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvagaṃ māṃ vijānīhi paramārthena nārada
yaḥ kariṣyati me stotraṃ stotreṇa tvatkṛtena tu //
meaning:
सर्वगं मां विजानीहि परमार्थेन नारद
यः करिष्यति मे स्तोत्रं स्तोत्रेण त्वत्कृतेन तु //
text_mt: know me in ultimate truth to be all-pervading, O Nārada. / Whoever offers praise to me with the hymn composed by you,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya kāmān vidhāsyāmi ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ
śvetadvīpe gatis tasya mṛtasya ca bhaviṣyati //
meaning:
तस्य कामान् विधास्यामि ये दिव्या ये च मानुषाः
श्वेतद्वीपे गतिस् तस्य मृतस्य च भविष्यति //
text_mt: I shall fulfill his desires, both celestial and human, / and after death, his destination shall be Śvetadvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetadvīpam avāpyāpi naraḥ svastho bhaviṣyasi
varāhasyāsya kalpasya yāvat kālo 'vaśiṣyate //
meaning:
श्वेतद्वीपम् अवाप्यापि नरः स्वस्थो भविष्यसि
वराहस्यास्य कल्पस्य यावत् कालो ऽवशिष्यते //
text_mt: Having reached Śvetadvīpa, you too, O man, will abide in your true nature, / as long as time remains in this Varāha kalpa.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāhe tu gate kalpe tato mātsyo bhaviṣyati
devakāryāṇi kāryāṇi subahūni yatas tvayā //
meaning:
वाराहे तु गते कल्पे ततो मात्स्यो भविष्यति
देवकार्याणि कार्याणि सुबहूनि यतस् त्वया //
text_mt: When the Vārāha kalpa has passed, then the Mātsya [kalpa] will take place; / since very many duties for the gods are to be performed by you,

sanskrit_iast:
prādurbhāvagataś cāham anuśāsyas tathā tvayā
prādurbhāvāṇi me brahman vyatītāni sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
प्रादुर्भावगतश् चाहम् अनुशास्यस् तथा त्वया
प्रादुर्भावाणि मे ब्रह्मन् व्यतीतानि सहस्रशः //
text_mt: and when I have entered manifestations, I am to be instructed by you. / My manifestations, O brahmin, that have passed are by the thousands;

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyanti tathānyāni tatra me śṛṇu kānicit
aham ekārṇave loke śeṣaparyaṅkaśāyikaḥ //
meaning:
भविष्यन्ति तथान्यानि तत्र मे शृणु कानिचित्
अहम् एकार्णवे लोके शेषपर्यङ्कशायिकः //
text_mt: likewise others will come to be. Hear of some among them from me: / When the world is a single ocean, lying on the couch of Śeṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīsahāyas tiṣṭhāmi yadā suptaḥ pitāmahaḥ
ahaṃ matsyas tathā kūrmo haṃso 'ham api nārada //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीसहायस् तिष्ठामि यदा सुप्तः पितामहः
अहं मत्स्यस् तथा कूर्मो हंसो ऽहम् अपि नारद //
text_mt: I abide accompanied by Lakṣmī, when the Grandfather sleeps. / I am the Fish, likewise the Tortoise, and I am also the Swan, O Nārada.

sanskrit_iast:
strīrūpeṇa mayā vipra vañcitā daityadānavāḥ
mayāśvaśirasā vedā dānavebhyas tathā hṛtāḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीरूपेण मया विप्र वञ्चिता दैत्यदानवाः
मयाश्वशिरसा वेदा दानवेभ्यस् तथा हृताः //
text_mt: In female form, O brahmin, the Daityas and Dānavas were deceived by me; / in horse-headed form, the Vedas were likewise recovered by me from the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
vārāheṇa mayā bhūtvā vasudheyaṃ samuddhṛtā
vārāheṇa mayā daityāḥ pātālatalagā hatāḥ //
meaning:
वाराहेण मया भूत्वा वसुधेयं समुद्धृता
वाराहेण मया दैत्याः पातालतलगा हताः //
text_mt: Having become the Boar, this earth was lifted up by me; / as the Boar, the Daityas dwelling in the depths of Pātāla were slain by me.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛvarāheṇa nihato hiraṇyākṣo balotkaṭaḥ
dānavāś ca hatā yuddhe naranārāyaṇātmanā //
meaning:
नृवराहेण निहतो हिरण्याक्षो बलोत्कटः
दानवाश् च हता युद्धे नरनारायणात्मना //
text_mt: Hiraṇyākṣa of vehement might was slain by the Man-Boar; / and the Dānavas were slain in battle by the self of Nara-Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
lokottare tathā mārge hariḥ kṛṣṇas tathāpy aham
nārasiṃhena rūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipur hataḥ //
meaning:
लोकोत्तरे तथा मार्गे हरिः कृष्णस् तथाप्य् अहम्
नारसिंहेन रूपेण हिरण्यकशिपुर् हतः //
text_mt: Likewise, in the transcendent path, I am Hari and Kṛṣṇa; / in the Man-Lion form, Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanena mayā bhūtvā bales tribhuvanaṃ hṛtam
tribhiḥ kramaiḥ purā brahman devānāṃ hitakāmyayā //
meaning:
वामनेन मया भूत्वा बलेस् त्रिभुवनं हृतम्
त्रिभिः क्रमैः पुरा ब्रह्मन् देवानां हितकाम्यया //
text_mt: Having become Vāmana, the three worlds were seized from Bali by me / with three strides formerly, O brahmin, desiring the welfare of the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
vāḍavo 'haṃ samudrasthaḥ pibāmi salilaṃ sadā
pṛthvī vasumatī brahman pṛthunā ca mayā kṛtā //
meaning:
वाडवो ऽहं समुद्रस्थः पिबामि सलिलं सदा
पृथ्वी वसुमती ब्रह्मन् पृथुना च मया कृता //
text_mt: I am the submarine fire abiding in the ocean, constantly drinking the water; / and the earth was made wealthy, O brahmin, by me as Pṛthu.

sanskrit_iast:
kapilena mayā duṣṭā dagdhavyāḥ sagarātmajāḥ
dattātreyeṇa vasudhā devā dvija.gaṇāḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
कपिलेन मया दुष्टा दग्धव्याः सगरात्मजाः
दत्तात्रेयेण वसुधा देवा द्विज.गणाः पुनः //
text_mt: As Kapila, the wicked sons of Sagara are to be burned by me; / as Dattātreya, the earth, the gods, and the hosts of the twice-born [are restored] again.

sanskrit_iast:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa laghvī vasumatī kṛtā
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ kartavyā kṣatrabhāraprapīḍitā //
meaning:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण लघ्वी वसुमती कृता
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः कर्तव्या क्षत्रभारप्रपीडिता //
text_mt: As Rāma, son of Jamadagni, the earth was made light; / three times seven times is it to be made [so], when afflicted by the burden of the kṣatriyas.

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā caturdhā putrāṃś ca mayā daśarathasya ca
rāmeṇa rāvaṇavadhaḥ kartavyo janatāsukham //
meaning:
दत्त्वा चतुर्धा पुत्रांश् च मया दशरथस्य च
रामेण रावणवधः कर्तव्यो जनतासुखम् //
text_mt: Having granted sons in fourfold form to Daśaratha, / the slaying of Rāvaṇa is to be done by me as Rāma for the happiness of the people.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ gandharvanidhanaṃ tathaiva bharatātmanā
meghanādavadhaḥ kāryo lakṣmaṇena tathā mayā //
meaning:
कार्यं गन्धर्वनिधनं तथैव भरतात्मना
मेघनादवधः कार्यो लक्ष्मणेन तथा मया //
text_mt: Likewise, the destruction of the Gandharvas is to be carried out through the form of Bharata; / the slaying of Meghanāda is likewise to be performed by me as Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śatrughnena ca kartavyo lavaṇasya vadhas tathā
mayā vālmīkinā kāryaṃ kāvyaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
शत्रुघ्नेन च कर्तव्यो लवणस्य वधस् तथा
मया वाल्मीकिना कार्यं काव्यं रामायणं तथा //
text_mt: And the slaying of Lavaṇa is to be performed by Śatrughna; / through me as Vālmīki the poetic composition, the Rāmāyaṇa, is to be composed.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsena vedā vaktavyā ākhyānaṃ bhārataṃ mahat
mayā brāhmaṇaśārdūla tathā dvaipāyanātmanā //
meaning:
व्यासेन वेदा वक्तव्या आख्यानं भारतं महत्
मया ब्राह्मणशार्दूल तथा द्वैपायनात्मना //
text_mt: As Vyāsa, the Vedas are to be declared, and the great narrative, the Bhārata, / by me, O tiger among brahmins, through the self of Dvaipāyana.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇḍoḥ putratvam āsādya pañcadhā ca tathā mayā
dvidhā ca vasudevasya laghvī kāryā vasuṃdharā //
meaning:
पाण्डोः पुत्रत्वम् आसाद्य पञ्चधा च तथा मया
द्विधा च वसुदेवस्य लघ्वी कार्या वसुंधरा //
text_mt: Having attained sonship to Pāṇḍu in fivefold form, and likewise by me / in twofold form to Vasudeva, the earth is to be made light.

sanskrit_iast:
naraloke nihantavyā daityā mānuṣarūpiṇaḥ
balabhadreṇa ca mayā hantavyā mauṣṭikādayaḥ //
meaning:
नरलोके निहन्तव्या दैत्या मानुषरूपिणः
बलभद्रेण च मया हन्तव्या मौष्टिकादयः //
text_mt: The Daityas in human form are to be slain in the world of mortals; / and by me as Balabhadra, Mauṣṭika and others are to be slain.

sanskrit_iast:
mayā kṛṣṇena hantavyāḥ kaṃsapūrvā mahābalāḥ
pradyumnena nihantavyaḥ śambaraś ca mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
मया कृष्णेन हन्तव्याः कंसपूर्वा महाबलाः
प्रद्युम्नेन निहन्तव्यः शम्बरश् च महाबलः //
text_mt: By me as Kṛṣṇa, Kaṃsa and the other mighty ones are to be slain; / and by Pradyumna, Śambara of great strength is to be slain.

sanskrit_iast:
hantavyāś cāniruddhena daityāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
sāmbena yuyudhānena mayā bhūtvā tathaiva ca //
meaning:
हन्तव्याश् चानिरुद्धेन दैत्याः शतसहस्रशः
साम्बेन युयुधानेन मया भूत्वा तथैव च //
text_mt: And Daityas by the hundreds and thousands are to be slain by Aniruddha; / likewise, having become Sāmba and Yuyudhāna by me,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā buddhena vaktavyā dharmāḥ kaliyuge punaḥ
hantavyā mleccharājānas tathā viṣṇuvaśātmanā //
meaning:
मया बुद्धेन वक्तव्या धर्माः कलियुगे पुनः
हन्तव्या म्लेच्छराजानस् तथा विष्णुवशात्मना //
text_mt: the dharmas are to be declared by me as the Buddha in the Kali age; / again, the barbarian kings are to be slain through the self of Viṣṇuyaśas [son, Kalki].

sanskrit_iast:
mamāṃśena vijānīhi pṛthivyāṃ cakravartinaḥ
ṛṣayaś ca tathā jñeyā mamaivāṃśasamudbhavāḥ //
meaning:
ममांशेन विजानीहि पृथिव्यां चक्रवर्तिनः
ऋषयश् च तथा ज्ञेया ममैवांशसमुद्भवाः //
text_mt: Know the universal monarchs upon earth to be from a portion of me; / and the ṛṣis are to be known as originating from a portion of me alone.

sanskrit_iast:
yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitam eva ca
tat tad evāvagacches tvaṃ mama tejo'ṃśasaṃbhavam //
meaning:
यद् यद् विभूतिमत् सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितम् एव च
तत् तद् एवावगच्छेस् त्वं मम तेजोऽंशसंभवम् //
text_mt: Whatever being possesses majesty, fortune, or strength, / understand every such thing to have arisen from a portion of my splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā bahunaitena kiṃ jñānena tavānagha
viṣṭabhyāham idaṃ kṛtsnam ekāṃśenāsthito jagat //
meaning:
अथ वा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञानेन तवानघ
विष्टभ्याहम् इदं कृत्स्नम् एकांशेनास्थितो जगत् //
text_mt: Or rather, what is the use of this extensive knowledge to you, O sinless one? / I abide supporting this entire universe with a single portion [of myself].

sanskrit_iast:
tad gaccha mānasī siddhiḥ sadā te 'stu dvijottama
kalpāvasānam āsādya maccharīraṃ pravekṣyasi //
meaning:
तद् गच्छ मानसी सिद्धिः सदा ते ऽस्तु द्विजोत्तम
कल्पावसानम् आसाद्य मच्छरीरं प्रवेक्ष्यसि //
text_mt: Therefore, go; may mental perfection always be yours, O best of the twice-born! / Reaching the end of the kalpa, you will enter my body.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvad uktvā vacanaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
bhagavān nāradaś cakre pujāṃ taddeśavāsinām //
meaning:
एतावद् उक्त्वा वचनं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
भगवान् नारदश् चक्रे पुजां तद्देशवासिनाम् //
text_mt: Having spoken this much, the Blessed One vanished right there; / Nārada performed worship of the inhabitants of that region.

sanskrit_iast:
taiś ca saṃpūjito vipras tān praṇamya yatavrataḥ
ājagāma tataḥ śīghraṃ naranārāyaṇāśramam //
meaning:
तैश् च संपूजितो विप्रस् तान् प्रणम्य यतव्रतः
आजगाम ततः शीघ्रं नरनारायणाश्रमम् //
text_mt: And honoured by them, the twice-born sage, firm in his vows, having bowed to them, / went from there swiftly to the hermitage of Nara-Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
pādayor nyapatat tatra sa tayor munipūjyayoḥ
tābhyāṃ saṃpūjito vipras tatrovāsa tadāśrame //
meaning:
पादयोर् न्यपतत् तत्र स तयोर् मुनिपूज्ययोः
ताभ्यां संपूजितो विप्रस् तत्रोवास तदाश्रमे //
text_mt: He fell there at the feet of the two who are revered by sages; / honoured by the two, the twice-born sage dwelt there in their hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kadācit taṃ vipram ūcatus tau tapodhanau
āvābhyāṃ tvaṃ tathā dṛṣṭaḥ śvetadvīpagate 'cyutaḥ //
meaning:
ततः कदाचित् तं विप्रम् ऊचतुस् तौ तपोधनौ
आवाभ्यां त्वं तथा दृष्टः श्वेतद्वीपगते ऽच्युतः //
text_mt: Then on one occasion those two rich in austerity said to that twice-born sage: / "Acyuta was seen by you in Śvetadvīpa just as by us,

sanskrit_iast:
samīpaṃ devadevasya taddehasthair yathāsukham
loke 'smin muniśārdūla nāsti dhanyataras tvayā //
meaning:
समीपं देवदेवस्य तद्देहस्थैर् यथासुखम्
लोके ऽस्मिन् मुनिशार्दूल नास्ति धन्यतरस् त्वया //
text_mt: near the God of gods at ease, like those residing in his body; / in this world, O tiger among sages, no one is more blessed than you,

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭavān asi yad brahman viśvarūpadharaṃ harim
trailokyasāraṃ viśveśaṃ praṇatārtivināśanam //
meaning:
दृष्टवान् असि यद् ब्रह्मन् विश्वरूपधरं हरिम्
त्रैलोक्यसारं विश्वेशं प्रणतार्तिविनाशनम् //
text_mt: since, O brahmin, you have seen Hari who bears the universal form, / the essence of the three worlds, lord of the universe, destroyer of the distress of those who bow.

sanskrit_iast:
yatas te 'nugrahas tena kṛto devena viṣṇunā
tato guhyaṃ nibodhemaṃ tatpūjāvidhim uttamam //
meaning:
यतस् ते ऽनुग्रहस् तेन कृतो देवेन विष्णुना
ततो गुह्यं निबोधेमं तत्पूजाविधिम् उत्तमम् //
text_mt: Since that grace was bestowed upon you by the god Viṣṇu, / therefore learn this secret, supreme rite of his worship,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakarmakaraṃ divyaṃ sakalārthapradaṃ śivam
nābhaktāya ca tad deyaṃ tvayā brāhmaṇasattama //
meaning:
सर्वकर्मकरं दिव्यं सकलार्थप्रदं शिवम्
नाभक्ताय च तद् देयं त्वया ब्राह्मणसत्तम //
text_mt: which accomplishes all tasks, is divine, yields all aims, and is auspicious; / and it should not be imparted by you to a non-devotee, O best of brahmins.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāntabhāvopagataṃ janārdanaṃ naras tu saṃpūjya tathā vidhānataḥ
prayāti taddvīpam anuttamaṃ śivaṃ na yatra gatvā vinivartate punaḥ //
meaning:
एकान्तभावोपगतं जनार्दनं नरस् तु संपूज्य तथा विधानतः
प्रयाति तद्द्वीपम् अनुत्तमं शिवं न यत्र गत्वा विनिवर्तते पुनः //
text_mt: Having worshipped Janārdana approached with exclusive devotion according to the prescribed rite, / a person proceeds to that supreme, auspicious island from which, having gone, one does not return again."

sanskrit_iast:
anena vidhinā yas tu viṣṇum abhyarcayen naraḥ
sarvān saṃsādhayed arthān kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate //
meaning:
अनेन विधिना यस् तु विष्णुम् अभ्यर्चयेन् नरः
सर्वान् संसाधयेद् अर्थान् कृतकृत्यो हि जायते //

sanskrit_iast:
nara-nārāyaṇāv ūcatuḥ
ādāv eva saraḥsaritprasravaṇasamīpagṛhopavanaparvatamastakānām anyatame hṛdye deśe susamaṃ
manoharaṃ hastamātraṃ maṇḍalakam upakalpayet //
meaning:
नर-नारायणाव् ऊचतुः
आदाव् एव सरःसरित्प्रस्रवणसमीपगृहोपवनपर्वतमस्तकानाम् अन्यतमे हृद्ये देशे सुसमं
मनोहरं हस्तमात्रं मण्डलकम् उपकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Nara and Nārāyaṇa said: / First of all, in any pleasant location—near a lake, a river, a spring, a house, a garden, or on the summit of a mountain—one should prepare a well-levelled, charming diagram measuring a cubit.

sanskrit_iast: tatra madhye 'ṣṭapatraṃ padmam ālikhet / tatas tūdāhṛtacaturasrayā caturdvāralekhayā vibhajet //
meaning: तत्र मध्ये ऽष्टपत्रं पद्मम् आलिखेत् / ततस् तूदाहृतचतुरस्रया चतुर्द्वारलेखया विभजेत् //
text_mt: There in the middle one should draw an eight-petalled lotus. Then one should divide it with the aforesaid square line possessing four gates.

sanskrit_iast: tataḥ padmakarṇikāmadhye śvetaṃ śatapatraṃ padmaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: ततः पद्मकर्णिकामध्ये श्वेतं शतपत्रं पद्मं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: Then, in the center of the lotus pericarp, one should meditate on a white hundred-petalled lotus.

sanskrit_iast: tatkarṇikopary arkamaṇḍala[ṃ] / tadupari candramaṇḍala[ṃ] / tadupar[y] agnimaṇḍala[ṃ] / tanmadhye paraṃ puruṣam aśarīram agandham arasam arūpam asparśam aśabdaṃ sarvagaṃ plutāntaṃ oṃkāraṃ vinyaset //
meaning: तत्कर्णिकोपर्य् अर्कमण्डल[ं] / तदुपरि चन्द्रमण्डल[ं] / तदुपर्[य्] अग्निमण्डल[ं] / तन्मध्ये परं पुरुषम् अशरीरम् अगन्धम् अरसम् अरूपम् अस्पर्शम् अशब्दं सर्वगं प्लुतान्तं ओंकारं विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: Above its pericarp [one should visualize] the solar orb; above that, the lunar orb; above that, the fire orb; in the middle of that, one should deposit the Supreme Person, bodiless, odourless, tasteless, formless, touchless, soundless, all-pervading, the syllable Om ending in a prolated vowel.

sanskrit_iast: kamalapūrvadale akāraṃ vāsudevaṃ nyaset / śvetavarṇaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: कमलपूर्वदले अकारं वासुदेवं न्यसेत् / श्वेतवर्णं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: On the eastern petal of the lotus, one should place the syllable 'A', Vāsudeva; one should meditate on him as white in color.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇe ākāraṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vinyaset / padmapatrābhaṃ taṃ ca dhyāyet //
meaning: दक्षिणे आकारं संकर्षणं विन्यसेत् / पद्मपत्राभं तं च ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: On the southern [petal], one should place the syllable 'Ā', Saṃkarṣaṇa; and one should meditate on him as having the radiance of a lotus petal.

sanskrit_iast: paścime dale oṃkār[aṃ] pradyumnaṃ vinyaset / pītavarṇaṃ ca dhyāyet //
meaning: पश्चिमे दले ओंकार्[अं] प्रद्युम्नं विन्यसेत् / पीतवर्णं च ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: On the western petal, one should place the syllable 'Oṃ', Pradyumna; and one should meditate on him as yellow in color.

sanskrit_iast: uttaradale aḥkāram aniruddhaṃ vinyaset / kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca dhyāyet //
meaning: उत्तरदले अःकारम् अनिरुद्धं विन्यसेत् / कृष्णवर्णं च ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: On the northern petal, one should place the syllable 'Aḥ', Aniruddha; and one should meditate on him as dark-blue in color.

sanskrit_iast: aiśāne dale tad iti brahmāṇaṃ vinyaset / padmapatrābhaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: ऐशाने दले तद् इति ब्रह्माणं विन्यसेत् / पद्मपत्राभं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: On the north-eastern petal, one should place 'Tat', Brahmā; one should meditate on him as having the radiance of a lotus petal.

sanskrit_iast: {.......?} / sūryakoṭisamaṃ dhyāyet //
text_mt: […] / one should meditate on [him as] equal to ten million suns.

sanskrit_iast: vāyavyadale varāhaṃ vinyaset / bhinnāñjanasamaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: वायव्यदले वराहं विन्यसेत् / भिन्नाञ्जनसमं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: On the north-western petal, one should place Varāha; one should meditate on him as resembling crushed collyrium.

sanskrit_iast:
prapūrvadvāre oṃ keṃ ṭeṃ yeṃ etāny akṣarāṇi vainateyaṃ vinyaset /
hemavarṇaṃ ca dhyāyet //
meaning:
प्रपूर्वद्वारे ओं कें टें यें एतान्य् अक्षराणि वैनतेयं विन्यसेत् /
हेमवर्णं च ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: At the eastern gate, [with] these syllables, 'oṃ keṃ ṭeṃ yeṃ', one should place Vainateya; / and one should meditate on him as golden-hued.

sanskrit_iast: dakṣiṇe dvāre tejoratharatṛ(?)cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ vinyaset / vajranābhaṃ sahasrāraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: दक्षिणे द्वारे तेजोरथरतृ(?)चक्रं सुदर्शनं विन्यसेत् / वज्रनाभं सहस्रारं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: At the southern gate, one should place the fiery chariot-wheel, the discus Sudarśana; one should meditate on it with a diamond navel, a thousand spokes, and brilliance equal to ten million suns.

sanskrit_iast: paścimadvāre śārṅgaṃ vinyaset / indracāpanibhaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: पश्चिमद्वारे शार्ङ्गं विन्यसेत् / इन्द्रचापनिभं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: At the western gate, one should place the bow Śārṅga; one should meditate on it as resembling a rainbow.

sanskrit_iast: sveṃ ṭheṃ heṃ theṃ uttare dvāre aniruddhaṃ nyasyet / sarvavarṇaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: स्वें ठें हें थें उत्तरे द्वारे अनिरुद्धं न्यस्येत् / सर्ववर्णं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'sveṃ ṭheṃ heṃ theṃ', at the northern gate one should place Aniruddha; one should meditate on him as all colors.

sanskrit_iast: veṃ ṇeṃ kṣeṃ kṣeṃ vidikṣu pāñcajanyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ nyaset / śaśāṅkavarṇaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: वें णें क्षें क्षें विदिक्षु पाञ्चजन्यं शङ्खं न्यसेत् / शशाङ्कवर्णं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'veṃ ṇeṃ kṣeṃ kṣeṃ', in the intermediate directions one should place the conch Pāñcajanya; one should meditate on it as the color of the moon.

sanskrit_iast: dheṃ heṃ bheṃ heṃ śriyaṃ padmaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset / śuklāṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: धें हें भें हें श्रियं पद्मं दक्षिणतो न्यसेत् / शुक्लां ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'dheṃ heṃ bheṃ heṃ', to the south one should place Śrī [on a] lotus; one should meditate on her as bright white.

sanskrit_iast: geṃ ḍeṃ veṃ śeṃ padmāntarataḥ puṣṭiṃ nyaset / śvetāṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: गें डें वें शें पद्मान्तरतः पुष्टिं न्यसेत् / श्वेतां ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'geṃ ḍeṃ veṃ śeṃ', within another lotus one should place Puṣṭi; one should meditate on her as white.

sanskrit_iast: heṃ seṃ purato vanamālāṃ nyaset / heṃ seṃ bahuvarṇāṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: हें सें पुरतो वनमालां न्यसेत् / हें सें बहुवर्णां ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'heṃ seṃ', in front one should place the garland of wild flowers (vanamālā); with 'heṃ seṃ' one should meditate on it as multicolored.

sanskrit_iast: cityaiśānyāṃ nandakaṃ nyaset / ākāśavarṇaṃ dhāyet //
meaning: चित्यैशान्यां नन्दकं न्यसेत् / आकाशवर्णं धायेत् //
text_mt: In the north-east [of the precinct], one should place the sword Nandaka; one should meditate on it as the color of the sky.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ ity āgneyyāṃ varma nyaset / bahuvarṇaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: ओं इत्य् आग्नेय्यां वर्म न्यसेत् / बहुवर्णं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'oṃ', in the south-east one should place the armor; one should meditate on it as multicolored.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ jheṃ leṃ śrīvatsaṃ nyaset / śukl[a]ṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: ओं झें लें श्रीवत्सं न्यसेत् / शुक्ल्[अ]ं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'oṃ jheṃ leṃ', one should place the Śrīvatsa; one should meditate on it as white.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ cheṃ ṭheṃ vāyavye kaustubhaṃ nyaset / ādityaṃ dīptaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: ओं छें ठें वायव्ये कौस्तुभं न्यसेत् / आदित्यं दीप्तं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: With 'oṃ cheṃ ṭheṃ', in the north-west one should place the Kaustubha; one should meditate on it as a blazing sun.

sanskrit_iast: tato maṇḍale bāhyasthāṃ yathāsvadiśam okāraukārau (?) dikpatī śakrāgnī yamanairṛtavāruṇapavanakuberān aiśānyāṃ nyaset / yathoktarūpaṃ dhyāyet //
meaning: ततो मण्डले बाह्यस्थां यथास्वदिशम् ओकारौकारौ (?) दिक्पती शक्राग्नी यमनैरृतवारुणपवनकुबेरान् ऐशान्यां न्यसेत् / यथोक्तरूपं ध्यायेत् //
text_mt: Then, on the outside of the maṇḍala, according to their respective directions, one should place the lords of the quarters, Śakra, Agni, Yama, Nirṛti, Varuṇa, Pavana, and Kubera, and in the north-east [Īśāna]; one should meditate on them according to their described forms.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyety antena dvādaśākṣareṇa karṇikāmadhye puruṣāyārghyapādyācamanīyānulepanapuṣpadīpadhūpamadhuparkanaivedyaphalabhakṣyāṇi nivedayet //
meaning: ओं नमो भगवते वासुदेवायेत्य् अन्तेन द्वादशाक्षरेण कर्णिकामध्ये पुरुषायार्घ्यपाद्याचमनीयानुलेपनपुष्पदीपधूपमधुपर्कनैवेद्यफलभक्ष्याणि निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: With the twelve-syllable [mantra] ending in 'oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya', one should offer to the Puruṣa in the center of the pericarp the respectful offering, water for the feet, sipping water, unguents, flowers, lamps, incense, honey mixture, food offerings, fruits, and eatables.

sanskrit_iast: oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyety athavāṣṭākṣareṇa mantreṇa / oṃ jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namas te viśvabhāvana / manas te 'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja //
meaning: ओं नमो नारायणायेत्य् अथवाष्टाक्षरेण मन्त्रेण / ओं जितं ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस् ते विश्वभावन / मनस् ते ऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुष पूर्वज //
text_mt: Or else with the eight-syllable mantra 'oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya'; [or with]: 'Oṃ! Victory to you, O Lotus-Eyed One! Homage to you, Creator of the Universe! Homage be to you, O Hṛṣīkeśa, Supreme Puruṣa, First-Born!'

sanskrit_iast: ity anena mantreṇa puruṣasūktena vā / athānyān dalaniviṣṭān devān yathābhihitair mantraiḥ pṛthakpṛthag arcaye[t] //
meaning: इत्य् अनेन मन्त्रेण पुरुषसूक्तेन वा / अथान्यान् दलनिविष्टान् देवान् यथाभिहितैर् मन्त्रैः पृथक्पृथग् अर्चये[त्] //
text_mt: With this mantra, or with the Puruṣasūkta. Then one should worship the other deities seated on the petals individually with the mantras prescribed for them.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā vyādhiṃ vyā[dh]itaṃ bhakṣayati na karoti na tad āpnoti idaṃ tv anyat / dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ puṇyaṃ ca pavitraṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
meaning: कृत्वा व्याधिं व्या[ध्]इतं भक्षयति न करोति न तद् आप्नोति इदं त्व् अन्यत् / धन्यं यशस्यं पुण्यं च पवित्रं पापनाशनं //
text_mt: […] It bestows wealth, brings renown, is meritorious, purifying, and destroys sin.

sanskrit_iast: ārogyaṃ dhanadhānyavardhanaṃ śatrughnaṃ vaśīkaraṇaṃ yaḥ puruṣo 'nena vidhinā satataṃ devam abhyarcayati saṃpattiṃ janayati athavā tasya na rocate tadā śvetadvīpam avpyāpya arkamaṇḍalaṃ bhittvā niruṇaddhi pradyumnasaṃkarṣaṇān prāpnoti sudevatvam avāpya niṣkalatvam āpnoti //
meaning: आरोग्यं धनधान्यवर्धनं शत्रुघ्नं वशीकरणं यः पुरुषो ऽनेन विधिना सततं देवम् अभ्यर्चयति संपत्तिं जनयति अथवा तस्य न रोचते तदा श्वेतद्वीपम् अव्प्याप्य अर्कमण्डलं भित्त्वा निरुणद्धि प्रद्युम्नसंकर्षणान् प्राप्नोति सुदेवत्वम् अवाप्य निष्कलत्वम् आप्नोति //
text_mt: It brings health, increases wealth and grain, destroys enemies, and causes subjugation. The man who constantly worships the Lord according to this rite produces prosperity; or, if he has no desire for that, then having reached Śvetadvīpa, breaking through the solar disc, he is unopposed, attains Pradyumna and Saṃkarṣaṇa, and having attained true divinity, he attains formlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca
etad dhi nāradaḥ śrutvā naranārāyaṇeritam
anenaiva vidhānena satataṃ madhusūdanam //
meaning:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच
एतद् धि नारदः श्रुत्वा नरनारायणेरितम्
अनेनैव विधानेन सततं मधुसूदनम् //
text_mt: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having heard this spoken by Nara-Nārāyaṇa, Nārada, / righteous-minded, constantly worshipped Madhusūdana / by this very rite, with his inner self directed toward him.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayām āsa dharmātmā tadgatenāntarātmanā
tataḥ puṃsavano bhagavān nāradasya mahātmanaḥ //
meaning:
पूजयाम् आस धर्मात्मा तद्गतेनान्तरात्मना
ततः पुंसवनो भगवान् नारदस्य महात्मनः //
text_mt: Then the Lord, the father of all, visibly spoke words to the great-souled Nārada who was present before him:

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣataḥ punar bhūtaṃ nāradaṃ vākyam abravīt
gaccha nārada bhadra tvaṃ lokāṃś cara yathepsitān //
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षतः पुनर् भूतं नारदं वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
गच्छ नारद भद्र त्वं लोकांश् चर यथेप्सितान् //
text_mt: 'Go, auspicious Nārada, travel the worlds as you desire; / I shall grant you sight [of myself] from time to time as desired.'

sanskrit_iast:
darśanaṃ tava dāsyāmi kālekāle yathepsite
anugraham idaṃ prāpya deveśāt puruṣottamāt //
meaning:
दर्शनं तव दास्यामि कालेकाले यथेप्सिते
अनुग्रहम् इदं प्राप्य देवेशात् पुरुषोत्तमात् //
text_mt: Having obtained this grace from Puruṣottama, the Lord of gods, / Nārada wandered the worlds, constantly worshipping Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
cacāra nārado lokān nityaṃ saṃpūjayan harim
viśvarūpam idaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nāradena mahātmanā //
meaning:
चचार नारदो लोकान् नित्यं संपूजयन् हरिम्
विश्वरूपम् इदं दृष्टं नारदेन महात्मना //
text_mt: This universal form was seen by the great-souled Nārada; / and again by Prahlāda when [the Lord] had the form of the Man-Lion;

sanskrit_iast:
prahlādena punas tena narakesarirūpiṇaḥ
tathā cāmṛtakādehe tenaiva ca mahātmanā //
meaning:
प्रह्लादेन पुनस् तेन नरकेसरिरूपिणः
तथा चामृतकादेहे तेनैव च महात्मना //
text_mt: likewise in the immortal body by that same great soul; / and formerly it was seen by Brahmā during the striding across the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇā ca purā dṛṣṭaṃ t[r]ailokyākramaṇe punaḥ
paścime sāgare dṛṣṭaṃ daśagrīveṇa rakṣasā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मणा च पुरा दृष्टं त्[र्]ऐलोक्याक्रमणे पुनः
पश्चिमे सागरे दृष्टं दशग्रीवेण रक्षसा //
text_mt: again it was seen at the western ocean by the rākṣasa Daśagrīva; / and in the incarnation as Kṛṣṇa, when the foe of Madhu had gone as an envoy,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāvatāre dūtyena gatasya madhuvidviṣaḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrasabhāmadhye ṛṣibhiś ca parīkṣitaḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णावतारे दूत्येन गतस्य मधुविद्विषः
धार्तराष्ट्रसभामध्ये ऋषिभिश् च परीक्षितः //
text_mt: he was witnessed by the sages in the assembly of the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra; / and so Arjuna saw [it] in the Mahābhārata battle,

sanskrit_iast:
mahābhāratasaṃgrāme dṛṣṭavān arjunas tathā
bandhunāśabhayodvigno yatra tena prabodhitaḥ //
meaning:
महाभारतसंग्रामे दृष्टवान् अर्जुनस् तथा
बन्धुनाशभयोद्विग्नो यत्र तेन प्रबोधितः //
text_mt: where, agitated by the fear of slaying his kinsmen, he was enlightened by him.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe gacchanto dvārakāṃ punaḥ
mārgāgatena tad dṛṣṭam uttaṅkena mahātmanā //
meaning:
निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे गच्छन्तो द्वारकां पुनः
मार्गागतेन तद् दृष्टम् उत्तङ्केन महात्मना //
text_mt: When the Bhārata war had ended, as he was returning to Dvārakā, / it was seen by the great-souled Uttaṅka who met him on the road.

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyanātho govindaḥ satataṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ
tasya karṃāṇi yo nityaṃ puruṣaḥ parikīrtayet //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यनाथो गोविन्दः सततं भक्तवत्सलः
तस्य कर्ंआणि यो नित्यं पुरुषः परिकीर्तयेत् //
text_mt: Govinda is the lord of the three worlds, ever affectionate to his devotees; / the man who constantly recites his deeds,

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṇuyād vā mahīpāla śucis tadgatamānasaḥ
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim //
meaning:
शृणुयाद् वा महीपाल शुचिस् तद्गतमानसः
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स याति परमां गतिम् //
text_mt: or listens to them, O king, pure and with mind focused on him, / is freed from all sins and goes to the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sa rājan dvijavaryamukhyaḥ saṃprāptavān devavarāt prasādam
bhaktikramakraiyanṛpaprasādāt tasmād dhi kāmān puruṣā labhante //
meaning:
एवं स राजन् द्विजवर्यमुख्यः संप्राप्तवान् देववरात् प्रसादम्
भक्तिक्रमक्रैयनृपप्रसादात् तस्माद् धि कामान् पुरुषा लभन्ते //
text_mt: Thus, O king, that foremost among the best of the twice-born attained grace from the best of gods; / for men obtain their desires through the grace of the King [of gods] which is purchased by the practice of devotion.
